title: weitere Assistenzkraft für mein buntes Assistenzteam gesucht (Krankenschwester/-pfleger)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Ergotherapeut*in; Heilerzieher/in; Krankenpflegehelfer/inStellenbeschreibung:Hallooo :)Rahmenbedingungen:- Teilzeit 25h/30h  Woche- 12h  Dienste nach Absprache- Vergütung je nach Qualifikation- Teamorientierte WochenendplanungBeginn: AB SOFORTManche Jobs fühlen sich einfach richtig an.Nicht, weil sie leicht sind, sondern weil das Miteinander stimmt.Genau so eine Assistenz suchen wir.Was uns wichtig ist, ist weniger ein perfekter Lebenslauf als eine Persönlichkeit mit Humor, Empathie, Offenheit, Kreativität und einer guten Portion Spontanität. Du solltest Freude daran haben, gemeinsam zu lachen, zuzuhören, mitzudenken und den Alltag aktiv mitzugestalten.Die Assistenz ist in der Regel 8-20 Uhr und 20-8 Uhr organisiert. Ab und zu kann es auch mal zu mehreren kurzen Diensten kommen, zum Beispiel bei Urlaub einer Kollegin.Am Wochenende wird ebenfalls Assistenz benötigt, was im Team fair aufgeteilt wird. Diese Tage bestehen meist aus einer längeren Schicht und bringen oft schöne Aktivitäten mit sich, etwa Ausflüge, Konzerte oder besondere Unternehmungen.Die Tätigkeit umfasst Assistenz im Alltag, Begleitung zu allen notwendigen Terminen, Begleitung mit dem E-Rollstuhl sowie leichte pflegerische Unterstützung. Heben ist nicht erforderlich.Was Dich erwartet, ist eine Arbeit auf Augenhöhe, geprägt von gegenseitigem Respekt, Vertrauen und einem wertschätzenden Umgang.Viele beschreiben sie eher als ein schönes Miteinander.Gesucht werden explizit:-Krankenpfleger/in  24€/h brutto-Pflegehelfer/in (2-jährige Ausbildung) 17,80€/h brutto-Physiotherapeut/in 22,50€/h brutto-Ergotherapeut/in 21€/h brutto-Heilerziehungpfleger/in 22€/h bruttoWenn du dich da siehst und Lust hast auf eine schöne Arbeitsatmosphäre, dann meld dich doch gerne! :)

title: Job Nr. 656 Wir suchen eine erfahrene Hauswirtschafterin in Vollzeit (m/w/d) (Hauswirtschafter/in)
description: Sie sehen, was zu tun ist. Und haben Freude daran, es richtig gut zu machen.Es gibt Häuser, in denen jedes Detail eine Geschichte erzählt. Hochwertige Materialien, ausgesuchte Kunst, liebevoll gestaltete Räume. Damit daraus ein Zuhause wird, in dem man sich rundum wohlfühlt, braucht es einen Menschen mit Überblick, Fingerspitzengefühl und Freude am eigenen Tun.Für einen anspruchsvollen Privathaushalt, eingebettet in die idyllische Natur des Nordschwarzwalds, suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die hauswirtschaftliche Verantwortung mit praktischem Können verbindet.Ihre Aufgabe: den Überblick behalten und selbst mit anpacken.Sie übernehmen die fachliche Führung und Organisation der Hauswirtschaft, stimmen sich mit den vorhandenen Haushaltshilfen ab und arbeiten aktiv im Tagesgeschehen mit. Sie planen vorausschauend, setzen Prioritäten und sorgen gemeinsam für ein verlässlich hohes Niveau an Sauberkeit, Ordnung und Wohnlichkeit.Dabei erkennen Sie, wo besondere Sorgfalt gefragt ist, welche Aufgaben heute Vorrang haben und wie sich Abläufe sinnvoll gestalten lassen. Sie führen durch Klarheit, einen respektvollen Umgang und Ihr eigenes gutes Beispiel.Hier können Sie Ihr Können einbringen- Sie strukturieren die täglichen und regelmäßig anfallenden hauswirtschaftlichen Aufgaben und koordinieren deren Umsetzung.- Sie übernehmen selbst die sorgfältige Reinigung und Pflege der Wohnräume.- Sie behandeln hochwertige Holz-, Stein- und weitere empfindliche Oberflächen mit dem passenden Fachwissen.- Sie organisieren und betreuen die Wäschepflege sowie den regelmäßigen Wechsel von Bettwäsche und Handtüchern.- Sie kümmern sich um Küche, Tischkultur und ein gepflegtes, einladendes Ambiente.- Sie behalten auch gelegentliche Aufgaben wie Fenster- und Vorhangpflege im Blick.- Sie gehen bewusst und sparsam mit Reinigungsmitteln und Ressourcen um.Was Sie auszeichnetSie bringen fundierte Erfahrung aus der gehobenen Hauswirtschaft, einem anspruchsvollen Privathaushalt oder dem Housekeeping mit. Vielleicht tragen Sie bereits Führungsverantwortung. Vielleicht sind Sie auch bereit, mit Ihrer Erfahrung den nächsten beruflichen Schritt zu gehen.Sie können Aufgaben verbindlich abstimmen, freundlich kommunizieren und selbstständig Entscheidungen im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich treffen. Ihr Blick fürs Detail verbindet sich mit einer strukturierten Arbeitsweise.Diskretion und ein feines Gespür für Privatsphäre sind für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie mögen Hunde und fühlen sich in einem Haushalt mit Tieren wohl. Ein Führerschein und zeitliche Flexibilität runden Ihr Profil ab.Der Rahmen für Ihre neue Aufgabe- Langfristig angelegte Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Wochenstunden.- Regelmäßige Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag, Beginn um 7:30 Uhr.- Gelegentliche Feiertagseinsätze nach Absprache.- Vergütung von 23 bis 25 Euro brutto pro Stunde.- Zusammenarbeit mit bereits vorhandenen Haushaltshilfen.- Eine Wohnmöglichkeit kann gegebenenfalls besprochen werden.- Arbeitsbeginn ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.Sie möchten Verantwortung übernehmen und am Ende des Tages sehen, was Sie gemeinsam geschafft haben?Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Erzählen Sie uns von Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrer Arbeitsweise und davon, was für Sie einen gut geführten Haushalt ausmacht.Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir selbstverständlich vertraulich.HerzlichstIhre Agentur Mary Poppins Freiburg

title: Senior Controller IT-Services & Business Operations (w/m/d) (Berufsspezialist/in - Fachberater/in - Servicemanagement)
description: Unsere Aufgabe war noch nie so wichtig wie heute. Als eines der größten staatlichen IT-Unternehmen gestalten wir den Weg der öffentlichen Verwaltung und der Gesellschaft in die digitale Zukunft. Wir schützen die Daten des Staates, der Unternehmen sowie der Bürgerinnen und Bürger. Damit schaffen wir Vertrauen und garantieren die digitale Souveränität des Staates. Wer bei uns etwas erreichen möchte, erhält unsere volle Unterstützung, denn als Team können wir am meisten bewegen und uns nachhaltig weiterentwickeln. Mit rund 6.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern machen wir digitale Zukunft. Mach mit!  Verstärke unser Team in Altenholz, Bremen, Flintbek, Halle (Saale), Hamburg, Magdeburg, Potsdam, Rostock.DEIN AUFGABENFELD- Aktive Mitgestaltung der wirtschaftlichen Steuerung von IT-Services und Weiterentwicklung des Business Operations Managements- Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung der Servicekostenrechnung sowie Abbildung technischer Leistungen in der Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung- Entwicklung neuer Steuerungsansätze, Methoden und Datenstrukturen für mehr Transparenz, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Effizienz- Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von KPIs, Reports und Steuerungsinformationen für Management und Serviceverantwortliche- Durchführung komplexer Kosten-, Wirtschaftlichkeits- und Angebotskalkulationen für IT-Services, Kundenangebote und Projekte- Beratung des Service Managements bei wirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungs- und Optimierungsempfehlungen- Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Steuerungsmodellen mit spürbarem Einfluss auf die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung von DataportDAS BRINGST DU MIT- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im IT-Controlling, Service-Controlling, Business Operations Management oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung, Kalkulation und Wirtschaftsplanung- Fundierte Erfahrung in der wirtschaftlichen Analyse und Steuerung von IT-Services und Kostenstrukturen- Gutes Verständnis von IT-Architekturen, IT-Infrastrukturen und den Leistungsprozessen eines komplexen IT-Service-Providers- Erfahrung mit Business Intelligence, Reporting und Kennzahlensystemen, idealerweise im Umfeld von Business-Warehouse-Lösungen- Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Stärke sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge in konkrete Steuerungsimpulse zu übersetzen- Bereitschaft zur Durchführung einer Sicherheitsüberprüfung nach dem Hamburgischen Sicherheitsüberprüfungs- und Geheimschutzgesetz (HmbSÜGG)DEINE BENEFITS - NIMM DIR, WAS DU BRAUCHST!- Flexibles Arbeiten: Gestalte deine Work-Life-Balance mit Gleitzeit, bis zu 80 % Remote Work sowie vielfältigen Arbeitsmodellen - von Teilzeit bis Workation.- Mehr Freiraum für dich: Genieße 30 Urlaubstage sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester für mehr Erholung im Alltag.- Sicher und fair vergütet: Profitiere von tarifgebundener Gehaltsentwicklung, Jahressonderzahlung sowie einem Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Alterversorgung (5,49 % des Bruttogehalts) und vermögenswirksamen Leistungen.- Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Nutze individuelle Karrierewege, fachliche Spezialisierungen und vielfältige Weiterbildungsangebote für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.- Gut versorgt im Alltag: Freue dich auf Gesundheitsangebote, Unterstützung in verschiedenen Lebenssituationen sowie Fitness- und Mobilitätsebenfits wie Radleasing und Jobticket.KONTAKT & WISSENSWERTESDiese Position wird nach Entgeltgruppe 14 TV Dataport vergütet (www.dataport.de/karriere/gehalt). Für eine problemlose Zuordnung deiner Bewerbung nenne uns bitte die Stellenkennziffer 11698-TQ6. Deine Ansprechpartnerin Steffi Smolka hilft dir bei Rückfragen unter karriere@dataport.de gerne weiter.Die Stelle ist wahlweise in Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder in Form von Jobsharing zu besetzen. Bei gleichwertiger Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung werden Frauen vorrangig berücksichtigt. Bewerbungen von Schwerbehinderten berücksichtigen wir bei gleicher Eignung besonders. Beamtinnen und Beamte können sich auf diese Stelle bewerben, sofern sie die laufbahn- und beamtenrechtlichen Voraussetzungen erfüllen. Bei Dataport schätzen wir Vielfalt als Stärke. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Lebenswegen gemeinsam innovative Lösungen für die digitale Zukunft gestalten. Jede Person ist willkommen - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Identität oder Weltanschauung.Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung als Senior Controller IT-Services & Business Operations (w/m/d)!

title: Senior / Staff Product Analyst - (Logistics, Service)  (Produktmanager/in - Modedesign und Bekleidung)
description: Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionTest fast. Learn faster. As a Staff or Senior Product Analyst to spearhead the data strategy for our Logistics Service product line. You will move beyond simple reporting to shape the future of our product through rigorous hypothesis testing and by converting massive datasets into high-impact strategic narratives. You will also tackle one of the industry's toughest challenges, automating customer support at a scale of billions of orders. Depending on your domain of focus, you will drive initiatives on cost-efficient chatbots, agent productivity, automated problem resolution, or predictive models for voucher and compensation issuance, all while balancing customer satisfaction with financial efficiency.The Service product line is where we ensure an amazing delivery and post-order experience for customers, riders, and vendors globally through user support applications, agent CRM products and chatbots. You'll join our Product Analytics team, embedded directly within the product organization, where we foster a "data-first" culture that drives tangible change in product development.In our Logistics Team, you'll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for customers, riders, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.- Define the North Star: Develop and refine product metrics and leading indicators that accurately reflect product health, customer satisfaction, and business viability.- Influence Roadmap: Use quantitative analysis to look beyond the numbers, providing the insights that empower Product Managers and Engineers to decide what to build and why, and Performance teams on how to localize solutions in the most efficient way.- Drive Experimentation: Plan, execute and analyze A/B tests and guide product and operations teams on methodology, design, interpretation, and decision-making, to ensure we only ship impactful features.- Build for Scale: Drive the development of scalable analytics infrastructure and self-service capabilities, ensuring data quality and accessibility across the organization.- Level up with GenAI: Push the frontier of analytics with GenAI, adapting our data stack and ways of working to match.- Elevate the Team: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other analysts, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing, rigorous peer review, and technical excellence. Act as a quality gatekeeper and champion a data-driven mindset across the Product and Tech teams.Qualifications- Education and experience: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field and 5+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Scientist, or similar role, preferably within fast-paced tech environments or marketplaces.- Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate abstract business goals into concrete analytics roadmaps. You understand the "business of the product."- SQL and Python: Expert-level SQL skills with practical experience on large-scale data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake), and solid Python skills for complex analytics and data visualization.- Data Curation: Proven ability to design, build, and optimize data pipelines. You take ownership of data curation to ensure that all business decisions are based on a foundation of reliable, high-quality data.- Experimentation: Solid understanding of A/B test design and edge cases. title: Sozialarbeiter/in (m/w/d) im BeWo  VZ/TZ für junge Flüchtlinge in Neuwied (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description: INSBI gGmbH / Institut für soziale und berufliche Integration gGmbHWir suchen:Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, Diplom/BA-Pädagoge/in, Erzieher/in,  (m/w/d)Zu uns:Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Für die individuelle, hochintensive Eins-zu-eins-Betreuung (Einzelfallhilfe im Team) eines 15-jährigen Mädchens suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – spätestens zum 01.01.2027 – mehrere engagierte, krisenerprobte und empathische Powerfrauen, die mit Herz und klarer Haltung Orientierung schenken.Hier bringst Du Dich ein – Dein Aufgabengebiet:Du begleitest ein 15-jähriges Mädchen mit hohem psychischen und pädagogischen Unterstützungsbedarf (u. a. Traumatisierungen, Bindungsstörungen und herausforderndes Verhalten) feinfühlig durch den Alltag.- Beziehungsarbeit: Du baust eine tragfähige, verlässliche und professionelle Beziehung zu der Jugendlichen auf – auch und gerade in schwierigen Momenten.- Alltagsstrukturierung: Du schaffst einen sicheren, verlässlichen Rahmen, begleitest Schul- oder Beschäftigungsprozesse und förderst Schritt für Schritt die Verselbstständigung.- Krisenintervention: In emotionalen Ausnahmesituationen reagierst Du deeskalierend, strukturiert und bewahrst einen kühlen Kopf.- Therapeutische Anbindung: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserem internen therapeutischen Fachdienst, unserer Psychiaterin sowie externen Kliniken und Fachleuten zusammen.- Dokumentation: Du führst die pädagogische Verlaufsdokumentation sorgfältig und wirkst aktiv an der Hilfeplanung mit.Das bringst Du mit ins Team:- Qualifikation: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Sozialen Arbeit / Sozialpädagogik, Heilpädagogik, Psychologie oder eine Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannte Erzieherin bzw. Heilerziehungspflegerin.- Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung aus den stationären Hilfen zur Erziehung (SGB VIII) mit und bist vertraut im Umgang mit Jugendlichen in schweren psychischen Krisen.- Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch eine hohe Frustrationstoleranz, emotionale Stabilität und Durchsetzungsvermögen aus. Du bringst eine klare, haltgebende und von Akzeptanz geprägte Haltung mit.- Arbeitsweise: Ein hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit, Reflexionsbereitschaft.- Flexibilität: Die Bereitschaft zum Schicht- und Wechseldienst (inklusive Nachtbereitschaften und Wochenenddiensten) ist für Dich selbstverständlich.Das wartet auf Dich – Unser Angebot:- Ein starkes Miteinander: Ein multiprofessionelles und herzliches Team aus pädagogischen Fachkräften, Psychologinnen, Kinder- und Jugendpsychotherapeuten sowie einer Psychiaterin, das gemeinsam an einem Strang zieht.- Beste Bedingungen: Ein intensiv betreutes Setting mit einem starken Personalschlüssel und engmaschiger kollegialer Unterstützung.- Fachlicher Rückhalt: Regelmäßige Supervisionen, Fall- und Teambesprechungen sowie maßgeschneiderte Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildungen (z. B. in Deeskalation oder Traumapädagogik wie PART oder ProDeMa).- Faire Vergütung: Ein attraktives Gehalt inklusive aller Zulagen für Schicht-, Wochenend- und Nachtarbeit.- Sicherheit: Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis bei einem etablierten und krisensicheren Träger.Hast Du die Ausdauer, die Professionalität und das Herz für diese intensive Aufgabe?Dann freuen wir uns sehr darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

title: staatl. anerk. Erzieher, Kindheits- oder Sozialpädagoge (m/w/d) (Erzieher/in)

title: Pädagogische Fachkraft (m/w/d) – Intensivpädagogische Einzelbetreuung (ISE) (Erzieher/in - Jugend- und Heimerziehung)

title: Referent*in als Elternzeitvertretung für die Region Südwest in der Fachstelle Altern und Pflege (Sozialwissenschaftler/in)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Verwaltungswissenschaft; ErziehungswissenschaftStellenbeschreibung:Referent*in als Elternzeitvertretung für die Region Südwest in der****Fachstelle Altern und Pflege im Quartier im Land Brandenburg [BB1] (https:#_msocom_1)  **(m/w/d)**Gesundheit Berlin-Brandenburg e. V.Kennziffer: 4/120/26Wir.Wirken.Gemeinsam. Wir von Gesundheit Berlin-Brandenburg e. V. haben die Vision, dass alle Menschen die gleichen Chancen auf ein selbstbestimmtes Leben in guter Gesundheit haben. Unser Verständnis von Gesundheitsförderung: Es ist gesellschaftliche Aufgabe, Lebensbedingungen so zu gestalten, dass Belastungen gemindert, Ressourcen gestärkt, Selbstwirksamkeit und Teilhabe ermöglicht werden. Mehr unter www.gesundheitbb.de (http://www.gesundheitbb.de) .Gut älter werden im vertrauten Wohnumfeld – das ist die Vision der Fachstelle Altern und Pflege im Quartier im Land Brandenburg (FAPIQ). Die Schaffung von alterns- und pflegefreundlichen Sozialräumen und Versorgungsstrukturen ist ein wichtiger Beitrag dazu. Die Fachstelle berät und begleitet Akteure in ganz Brandenburg insbesondere zu den Themenbereichen „Alltagsunterstützende Angebote und Nachbarschaftshilfe“, Alternsgerechte Quartiersentwicklung und Wohnen, sowie zur zu pflegerischen Versorgungsstrukturen und Pflegenetzwerke. Im Zentrum der Arbeit der Fachstelle steht die Beratung und Begleitung von lokalen Akteuren, insbesondere Kommunen bei der Umsetzung des Förderprogramms „Pflege vor Ort“. Für unser Projektteam (FAPIQ) suchen wir ab sofort eine*n engagierte*n Regionalreferent*in als Elternzeitvertretung. Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Stunden) in unserer Geschäftsstelle in Potsdam zunächst befristet bis zum 31.01.2028 zu besetzen. Daran können Sie mitwirken! Es erwartet Sie ein vielfältiges kreatives Arbeitsfeld mit engagierten, spannenden Akteuren, zukunftsweisenden Konzepten und diversen Zielgruppen! Ihre Aufgaben: Sie sind eine der beiden regionalen Expert*innen für die Akteure und die Vernetzung in der Region Südwest. Die Region umfasst die Landkreise Potsdam-Mittelmark, Teltow-Fläming, Elbe-Elster sowie die kreisfreien Städte Potsdam und Brandenburg an der Havel.- Sie beraten und begleiten die Akteure (Kommunen, Wohlfahrtsverbände und Organisationen der Zivilgesellschaften) in der Region zu den Themen der Fachstelle, um alterns- und pflegefreundliche Lebenswelten aufzubauen.  - Sie sind die regionale Unterstützungsstruktur für das kommunale Förderprogramm „Pflege vor Ort“ und stehen in einem regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Kommunen. - Sie kennen und vernetzen Akteure aus den Bereichen Altern und Pflege in der Region. Die Region liegt in der Zuständigkeit von zwei Mitarbeitenden. Sie arbeiten eng mit einer weiteren Kollegin zusammen. Ihr Profil: - Brandenburg und die Lebenssituation von älteren Menschen und Menschen mit Pflegebedarf liegt Ihnen am Herzen.- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Gerontologie, Pflege-, Gesundheits-, Sozial-, Erziehungs- oder Verwaltungswissenschaft, der Sozialen Arbeit, Public Health oder einen vergleichbaren Bereich und verfügen über fachspezifische Berufserfahrung. - Sie haben grundlegende Kenntnisse der Regionalstruktur Brandenburgs sowie der Verwaltungsstrukturen und – prozesse im Land und auf Ebene der Kommunen, insbesondere die Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte der Region Südwest sind Ihnen vertraut. Sie kennen die regionalspezifische Akteurslandschaft in der Pflege. - Sie können sich die gesetzlichen Grundlagen der Leistungen der Pflegeversicherung im Rahmen des SGB XI aneignen und zu diesen zielgruppengerecht beraten. - Fachliche Inhalte werden von Ihnen verständlich für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen aufbereitet. - Die fachliche Vernetzung mit unterschiedlichen Akteuren bereitet Ihnen Freude. Es macht Ihnen Freude, Ideen auszutauschen und gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln. Sie befördern engagiert Kooperationen und Zusammenarbeit. - Teamarbeit und eigenverantwortliches Engagement sind für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie kommunizieren klar und wertschätzend und übernehmen gern Verantwortung. Es fällt Ihnen leicht, sich auf neue Situationen einzulassen und auch bei vielfältigen Anforderungen den Überblick zu behalten.- Die Bereitschaft zur Mobilität, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Fahrerlaubnis und Fahrpraxis sind Voraussetzung für die Tätigkeit. Unser Angebot:- Ein Job mit Sinn - wir sind ein Träger mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Gesundheitsförderung und Prävention.- Wir bezahlen in Anlehnung an den TV-L E10 (bei passenden Voraussetzungen)- Mit uns lassen sich Familie und Beruf sehr gut vereinbaren.- Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden bedarfsgerechte Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten. Sie erhalten eine qualifizierte Einarbeitung durch das Team und werden gut in die Trägerstruktur integriert.- Sie wirken in einem interessanten und abwechslungsreichen Handlungsfeld mit und leisten einen Beitrag, dass in Brandenburg alterns- und pflegefreundliche Sozialräume entstehen.- Mobiles Arbeiten ist unter Berücksichtigung dienstlicher Belange, die eine Anwesenheit in der Geschäftsstelle oder bei Veranstaltungen und Terminen mit Partnerinnen und Partnern vor Ort notwendig machen, möglich. title: Senior Software Engineer - (Fintech) (Bachelor Professional - IT (Softwareentwicklung))
description: Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionBig systems. Exciting challenges. Real impact. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll build and scale the internal Payments engine that handles payments for the entire Delivery Hero. Your work keeps checkout reliable and payment failures low for customers across our markets.Our Fintech team builds Wallet, Payment, and Anti-Fraud solutions worldwide. You’ll focus on the core payment features that manage the lifecycle of different payment flows, ensuring consistency and reliability of payment operations.Be part of building the financial backbone of Delivery Hero. You’ll develop products that empower millions of customers and merchants, from seamless payments to innovative financial solutions like wallets and credit. Your work will support our path to profitability by creating financial flexibility for users and enabling smooth transactions across our markets.- Design, build, and deliver highly scalable software systems in complex, global environments used across more than 70 countries, applying secure coding practices throughout the development lifecycle- Lead backend engineering efforts with a focus on distributed systems, using Java, Kotlin, Spring / Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JUnit, and drive architectural decisions for your features with design patterns, SOLID principles, and Domain-Driven Design- Own services end-to-end with a “you build it, you run it” mindset, including infrastructure automation and continuous deployment- Define and apply testing strategies across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end levels- Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across multi-region, distributed microservices, and promote reliability, on-call, and observability best practices- Mentor teammates and evangelize engineering best practices to continuously improve how the team builds and ships softwareQualifications- Proven experience designing and delivering software systems in complex business domains at global scale, within fintech or payments- Deep backend engineering expertise, with a strong preference for distributed systems- Hands-on expertise in Java, Kotlin, Spring / Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JUnit- A strong engineering ownership mindset with a passion for automation, CI/CD, and reliability- Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity in approaching complex challenges- A high bar for quality, performance, and attention to detailNice to have- Experience in payments, wallet, or anti-fraud domains- Experience with event-driven architectures (e.g. Kafka)- Experience mentoring other engineersAdditional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? title: Director Global HR (m/f/d) - Technology and Digital Transformation (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Personalmanagement)

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description: To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.Your mission- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline- Following this setup phase, you will: - get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: Commercial Manager
description: Hrein Snilld is seeking a Commercial Manager to oversee and streamline daily operations across our commercial cleaning services, residential accounts, and central Reykjavík laundry unit. title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Gera þarf ráð fyrir dag-, kvöld- og helgarvöktum.Grunnlaun eru 680.000 kr. á mánuði fyrir 100% starf, auk vaktaálags, yfirvinnu og annarra greiðslna samkvæmt kjarasamningi Starfsgreinasambands Íslands (SGS) og Samtaka atvinnulífsins (SA) vegna veitinga-, gisti-, þjónustu- og greiðasölustaða, afþreyingarfyrirtækja og hliðstæðrar starfsemi 2024–2028.Æskilegt er að viðkomandi geti hafið störf eins fljótt og auðið er, samkvæmt samkomulagi og að loknu ráðningarferli. Ef atvinnuleyfis er krafist getur viðkomandi ekki hafið störf fyrr en leyfið hefur verið veitt.Umsækjendur skulu senda ferilskrá, upplýsingar um starfsreynslu og meðmæli, ef þau liggja fyrir, á winehf@gmail.com.------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Down Town ehf. is seeking to hire one Chef with experience in Vietnamese cuisine for a permanent full-time position (100%) in Arnarstapi, Iceland.Key Responsibilities:Prepare and cook Vietnamese dishes.Participate in the setup, organization, and preparation of the kitchen prior to the opening of the establishment.Prepare ingredients and organize daily food production.Assist in menu development and standardization.Monitor food quality, portion sizes, and presentation standards.Carry out cleaning duties and ensure compliance with hygiene and food safety regulations.Work collaboratively with other staff members and perform general kitchen duties as required.Qualifications:Proven experience preparing Vietnamese cuisine.Previous experience working in a professional kitchen.Knowledge of hygiene and food safety practices.Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.Punctual, reliable, and able to maintain high work standards.Ability to communicate in either Icelandic or English.Formal culinary education is an advantage but not a requirement.Working Hours: This is a full-time position (40 hours per week). Work is performed according to a shift schedule and may include day, evening, and weekend shifts.The base salary is ISK 680,000 per month for a full-time position, in addition to shift differentials, overtime pay, and other payments in accordance with the collective agreement between the SGS and SA for restaurants, accommodation providers, service establishments, entertainment companies, and related activities for the period 2024-2028.The preferred start date is as soon as possible, by mutual agreement and following the completion of the recruitment process.If a work permit is required, employment cannot commence until the permit has been granted.Applicants are requested to submit a CV, details of relevant work experience, and references (if available) to: winehf@gmail.comApplicants will be considered on the basis of their qualifications, experience, and suitability for the position.

title: Uppvaskari/Dishwasher
description: Full-Time Dishwasher**Job Description:**Hotel Skogafoss is looking for a reliable and hardworking full-time dishwasher to join our kitchen team. Starfið er eingöngu opið fyrir langtímaumsækjendur sem geta viðhaldið ströngustu kröfum um hreinlæti í hröðu og krefjandi umhverfi.**Helstu verkefni:*** Notkun uppþvottavélar til að þrífa diska, glös og hnífapör.* Handþvottur á pottum, pönnum og öðrum eldhúsáhöldum þegar þörf krefur.* Tryggja að allir hlutir séu rétt geymdir eftir þvott.* Viðhalda hreinu og skipulögðu uppþvottasvæði.* Aðstoða við almenn þrif í eldhúsi, þar með talið að sópa og skúra gólf.* Förgun sorps og endurvinnslu.* Aðstoða eldhústeymið til að tryggja hnökralausan rekstur.**Hæfniskröfur:*** Fyrri reynsla sem uppþvari eða í svipuðu hlutverki er kostur en ekki skilyrði.* Hæfni til að vinna á skilvirkan hátt í hröðu umhverfi.* Nákvæmni í vinnubrögðum varðandi hreinlæti.* Góð færni í hópavinnu og samskiptum.* Áreiðanleiki, stundvísi og jákvætt viðmót eru skilyrði.* Góð enskukunnátta.**Við bjóðum:*** Húsnæði gegn gjaldi.* Laun greidd samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi VFLS**Umsókn:**Vinsamlegast sæktu um eins fljótt og auðið er þar sem umsóknir eru skoðaðar jafnóðum.Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: Applications@ejhotels.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 31.10.2026

Kunnátta í öðrum tungumálum er mikill kostur.* Gilt ökuskírteini (B-flokkur) er skilyrði.* Áreiðanleiki, jákvæðni og hæfni til að vinna vel í hóp.* Sveigjanleiki og vilji til að vinna á breytilegum vöktum.**Það sem við bjóðum:*** Öruggt fullt starf á vinalegum og lifandi vinnustað.* Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi við VLFS.* **Húsnæði er í boði á staðnum gegn gjaldi.*** Einstakt tækifæri til að búa og starfa á einum fallegasta stað landsins.**Umsóknir:**Farið er yfir umsóknir jafnóðum.Áhugasamir vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: applications@ejhotels.isUmsóknarfrestur er til og með 31.okt 2026.

title: Driller
description: Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members. Currently, we are seeking skilled assistant driller to join our team for a long-term geothermal drilling projects.Position Overview:As a driller, you will be responsible for operating and supervising the drilling operations on the rig. This is a 37.5 hour permanent contract based in our Support Office - Eason, Block 4, First Floor, Swords Business Park, Swords, Co. Dublin K67 X903. The salary on offer is €41,000.Key Responsibilities:- Business Process and ERP Support - Work with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 for day-to-day supply chain processes involving products, inventory, purchasing, stock and replenishment. Identify and raise system or process-related issues where required. - Support the ongoing upgrade from Dynamics AX 2012 to Dynamics 365 by helping document current business processes and prepare relevant testing scenarios to support the transition to the new system.- Reporting Requirements and System Support - Work with buyers and the Supply Chain Manager to understand reporting requirements, identify any additional information or fields needed, and communicate these requirements or issues to the relevant IT/support teams.- Data Analysis and Reporting - Analyse sales, revenue, warehouse stock, store stock, purchase orders and forecast data using Excel, Power Query, DAX and Power BI. Combine information from different sources to create clear reports for business and management use.- Weekly Performance Analysis - Prepare weekly trackers to analyse week-on-week and year-on-year sales performance, stock levels, and product performance. Use this analysis to identify products that may require additional replenishment, allocation or other action.- Store Replenishment Planning - Plan weekly replenishment quantities for stores based on sales performance, available stock, seasonal demand, promotions, planned events, and product forecasts. Implement the final replenishment quantities within the supply chain process.- Purchase Order and Stock-Flow Planning - Review incoming purchase orders and decide whether stock should be cross-docked directly to stores or received into the warehouse for normal replenishment, depending on priority, demand and stock requirements.- System and Reporting Issue Coordination - Investigate missing or incorrect information in reports where identified, raise relevant issues with IT/system support teams, and explain the business requirement or correction needed.- Stakeholder Coordination - Work closely with buyers, warehouse teams, stores to resolve issues and ensure stock, reporting and operational processes run smoothly.- Supplier Performance Reporting - Prepare and share regular performance reports with external suppliers covering relevant sales, stock, and product performance information.Candidate Requirements: - 3rd level degree in Supply Chain or other relevant field- Previous Supply Chain experience- 1-2 years experience in an analytical role- Good working knowledge of Excel, Power BI, Power Query- Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics AX is an advantage, but not an necessity

title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
description: Per conto di LPM Prefabbricati (https://www.lpmpref.it/) storica azienda con presenza consolidata sul mercato italiano nella fabbricazione di prefabbricati di grandi dimensioni, ricerchiamo un* Geometra con circa 10 anni di esperienza per un ruolo di Responsabile di Commessa con forte presenza in cantiere. La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo sarà assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Programmare gli step operativi giornalieri/settimanali, e seguire l'avanzamento dei lavori. Coordinamento squadre di cantiere e subappaltatori: organizzazione, controllo operatività, gestione comportamenti e standard (es. riduzione inefficienze). Interfaccia con clienti: gestione richieste e criticità con approccio pratico (es. rimodulare l'ordine di montaggio per rispettare esigenze del cliente senza perdere controllo su tempi/costi). Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Requisiti: Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). ~10 anni di esperienza in cantieri industriali con responsabilità di capocantiere, o responsabile operativo, o responsabile commessa. Preferibile esperienza in prefabbricati o provenienza da imprese di costruzioni Competenze di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. La risorsa sarà inserita all'interno del team customer service e avrà la responsabilità di garantire una gestione completa, accurata e tempestiva del ciclo dell'ordine per clienti nazionali ed esteri, fungendo da punto di contatto operativo tra cliente e azienda. In particolare, si occuperà della gestione quotidiana degli ordini clienti dalla loro acquisizione tramite gestionale aziendale fino all'evasione e alla consegna finale, verificando la correttezza dei dati inseriti, la disponibilità dei prodotti e il rispetto delle tempistiche concordate. description: Per importante realtà manifatturiera nostra cliente ricerchiamo un/una SENIOR HSE SPECIALIST / ASPP. Responsabilità principali Condurre attività di valutazione dei rischi e contribuire alla stesura/aggiornamento del DVR e della documentazione correlata. Definire e implementare misure di prevenzione e protezione, monitorandone l'efficacia tramite audit, verifiche e indicatori. Gestire e aggiornare lo scadenziario relativo ad adempimenti normativi (safety e ambiente) e requisiti volontari. Coordinare il supporto di consulenti esterni per valutazioni specifiche (es. rumore, chimico, ATEX, ergonomia, movimentazione manuale, ecc.). Pianificare ed erogare (o far erogare) la formazione HSE e la sensibilizzazione del personale, anche con iniziative sul campo. Gestire la sorveglianza sanitaria in collaborazione con il Medico Competente (programmi, idoneità, tracciabilità). Presidiare la qualifica e gestione HSE degli appaltatori: accessi, documentazione, permessi di lavoro e DUVRI. Curare la gestione delle sostanze chimiche (valutazione rischio, conformità, impatti ambientali, schede sicurezza, omologazioni/approvazioni interne). Supportare la verifica dei processi produttivi e delle modalità operative per ridurre rischi e impatti ambientali. Contribuire agli adempimenti ambientali (autorizzazioni, prescrizioni, monitoraggi e attività analitiche). Mantenere e migliorare procedure e istruzioni operative del Sistema di Gestione secondo ISO 45001 e ISO 14001, supportando audit interni/esterni. Promuovere la cultura della sicurezza e programmi di sicurezza comportamentale, favorendo il coinvolgimento attivo dei lavoratori. Analizzare near miss, incidenti e infortuni con approccio root cause, definendo e tracciando azioni correttive/preventive. Collaborare con l'HSE Manager su iniziative di sostenibilità e miglioramento delle performance ambientali. Requisiti Laurea (preferibile indirizzo ingegneristico/tecnico con focus HSE o affini). Abilitazione ASPP (Moduli A e B). Esperienza consolidata in ruolo HSE in contesti manifatturieri/industriali. Conoscenza operativa delle norme ISO 45001 e ISO 14001. Offerta Contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Metalmeccanico, livello impiegatizio. RAL indicativa 45.000 - 55.000 € + variabile. RAL commisurata a esperienza e competenze. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, capacità di lavorare in team e orientamento al risultato. Sede di lavoro: Sondrio con smart working 8 gg/mese. È richiesta motivazione al trasferimento; è previsto un pacchetto di relocation (inclusa foresteria, contributo spese viaggio) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. Soft skills: analisi, problem solving, teamwork, collaborazione cross-funzionale. Inglese buono/fluente. Orario di lavoro: Full time 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al venerdì. Richiesta presenza in plant, con con possibilità di smart working fino a 8 giorni al mese. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato; CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico; Livello di inquadramento: B2. La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 45.000 lordi annui (RAL), definita in base all'inquadramento, alle mansioni e alle caratteristiche del profilo. Sono inoltre previsti mensa aziendale, piano welfare, pacchetto benefit dedicato alla cura della persona e formazione tecnica continua sulle tecnologie avanzate utilizzate all'interno del reparto Engineering. Sede di lavoro: San Giovanni Teatino (CH), con contributo mensile alla relocation per candidati/e provenienti da fuori regione. description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione.
