Om arbeidsgiveren:

De største samfunnsutfordringene krever forskjellige hoder, forskjellige måter å tenke på og at forskjellige fagområder jobber sammen. Når flinke folk fra ulike fagområder jobber sammen, finner vi smartere løsninger som sikrer et velfungerende skattesystem. Vi består av et direktorat, fem divisjoner som har landsdekkende ansvar, og viktigst av alt: litt over 7 000 medarbeidere fra forskjellige fagområder med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring, måter å tenke på og perspektiver. Vil du bli enda bedre kjent med oss kan du lese mer på skatteetaten.no

title: NB BYGG AS søker hjelpearbeider innen byggebransjen
description:
Vi fra NB BYGG AS søker en motivert og arbeidsom hjelpearbeider til byggebransjen. Vi ser etter deg som er praktisk anlagt, lærevillig og pålitelig. For den rette kandidaten er det mulighet for fast ansettelse på sikt.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en arbeidsom, pålitelig og motivert person som trives med fysisk arbeid og ønsker å jobbe innen fasade og bygg. Du er praktisk anlagt, lærevillig og samarbeider godt med andre. Erfaring fra byggebransjen er en fordel, men ikke et krav, da opplæring vil bli gitt.

Det er en fordel om du snakker russisk, ukrainsk eller rumensk, da dette kan gjøre kommunikasjonen med arbeidslaget enklere. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke. Du må være punktlig, følge instrukser og ha fokus på kvalitet og sikkerhet i arbeidet. Førerkort klasse B er en fordel.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Hjelpe til med fasadearbeid og rehabilitering av fasader

  • Bistå med etterisolering av bygninger

  • Hjelpe til med demontering og utskifting av gammel kledning

  • Montering av ny kledning og ulike fasadeelementer

  • Håndtering og transport av byggematerialer og verktøy

  • Klargjøring og rydding av arbeidsplassen

  • Bistå fagarbeidere med praktiske oppgaver på byggeplassen

Vi tilbyr

NB BYGG AS tilbyr en praktisk og variert arbeidshverdag innen fasadearbeid, etterisolering, utskifting av kledning og montering. Du får mulighet til å lære nye ferdigheter og utvikle deg gjennom praktisk arbeid sammen med erfarne medarbeidere. Vi tilbyr et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, varierte arbeidsoppgaver og mulighet for fast ansettelse på sikt for den rette kandidaten.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NB BYGG AS er en bedrift innen byggebransjen som utfører fasadearbeid, etterisolering, utskifting av kledning og ulike typer monteringsarbeid. Vi legger vekt på kvalitet, godt samarbeid og effektiv gjennomføring av arbeidsoppgaver.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry, available at Department of Chemistry, theoretical chemistry section.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.03.2027 . The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year maybe considered and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is The Life Science Building at Blindern, Oslo.

Project description

A PhD position is available at the Section for Theoretical Chemistry, Department of Chemistry, University of Oslo, within the project Molecular Atmospheric Chemistry on Alien Worlds (MACAW), funded by the Research Council of Norway.In this project we will employ quantum chemistry methods using high-performance computing (HPC) resources to study chemical reactions, photochemistry, identify spectral signatures for potential detection and elucidate condensation mechanisms for molecules in atmospheres beyond that of contemporary Earth. The project has a particular focus on Sulfur and Chlorine chemistry as well as isotopic fractionation processes.The successful applicant will have freedom to pursue specific research topics within the relatively wide project framework, in coordination with the supervisor. The work is first and foremost computational utilizing electronic structure methods to qualitatively study photochemical and thermal reaction mechanisms, as well as quantify reaction rates, UV-Vis spectra and other molecular properties relevant to studying the role of molecules in planetary atmospheres.

The work has a high degree of international collaboration within the main project supervisors' network currently spanning four continents among seven nations. This is to ensure maximal dissemination and impact of the project results, and thus the project will likely involve more than a usual amount of both hosting international visitors and travel to visit our collaborators.The project work is highly flexible, allowing the successful candidate to structure their own work.This project is an excellent opportunity for a prospective PhD candidate to make original and foundational contributions to the field of planetary atmospheric chemistry, with the potential for leading to groundbreaking discoveries of new molecules or chemical processes on other planets.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physics, nanoscience or related fields. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience in utilizing computational resources and code for simulations of molecular properties
  • Experience with quantum chemistry calculations
  • Experience with scripting or programming (e.g. Python, Bash, Matlab, Fortran), and high-performance computing 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in electronic structure methods, e.g. DFT, coupled cluster or multireference methods
  • Background in chemical kinetics, reaction mechanisms, photochemistry, spectroscopy, transition state theory, atmospheric chemistry and/or physical chemistry
  • Any insights into planetary/exoplanetary science and photochemical atmospheric modeling 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A fundamental drive for scientific research, keenness/eagerness in challenging work with limited repetitiveness which requires continued learning
  • A strong interest in atmospheric, planetary and/or exoplanet science
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of an international, interdisciplinary team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks. The work is very flexible which requires discipline
  • Direct communication skills and excellent collaboration
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

Hylleraas Centre for Quantum Molecular Sciences operates under the aegis of the Department of Chemistry at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The Department of Chemistry  is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. 

The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

title: Geodataforvalter
description:
Vil du bidra til at NVDB og FKB-data fra utbyggingsprosjekter blir til varige verdier for drift og forvaltning av fylkesvegnettet? Vi søker en geodataforvalter som skal være bindeleddet mellom utbyggingsprosjekter og geodataforvaltningen i Buskerud fylkeskommune. Stillingen skal bidra til at NVDB og FKB-data følger prosjektet hele veien fra utbygging til forvaltning, og at oppdaterte data blir registrert i nasjonale databaser til støtte for drift, vedlikehold og videre utvikling av fylkesvegnettet.Du vil samarbeide tett med prosjektledere, byggeledere, entreprenører og utbyggere, og bidra til at krav til NVDB og FKB-data ivaretas gjennom hele prosjektet.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å sikre at investeringer i fylkesvegnettet blir dokumentert og tatt vare på gjennom gode geodata. Du blir fagressurs mellom de som planlegger og bygger, og de som skal drifte og forvalte fylkesvegene i årene som kommer. Gjennom arbeidet ditt bidrar du til bedre datakvalitet, mer effektive arbeidsprosesser og et mer datadrevet beslutningsgrunnlag for fremtidens samferdsel.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • være fylkeskommunens fagressurs for NVDB og FKB-data fra utbyggingsprosjekter og sikre at krav til leveranse blir ivaretatt i både interne prosjekter, og prosjekter utført av eksterne aktører via gjennomføringsavtaler.
  • delta på oppstartsmøter og informere utbyggere, entreprenører og med hensyn til krav og leveranser av NVDB og FKB-leveranse.
  • etablere og videreutvikle rutiner som sikrer at fylkeskommunen mottar nødvendig NVDB og FKB-data i henhold til gjeldende krav.
  • kontrollere, kvalitetssikre, sammenkoble og stedfeste data før overføring til NVDB.
  • oppdatere FKB gjennom Sentral felles kartdatabase (SFKB).
  • bearbeide og overlevere nytt vegnett til Statens vegvesen.
  • bidra til at NVDB og FKB blir en integrert del av prosjektgjennomføringen og overgangen fra utbygging til drift og vedlikehold.

Andre oppgaver innen geodatafaget kan også bli aktuelt.

  • For den rette kandidaten kan det også være aktuelt å bidra mot utbyggings- og prosjekteringsavdelingen med:enklere kontrollmåling og mengdeberegninger.
  • bestilling og oppfølging av fastmerker og grunnlagsnett.
  • kontroll og bearbeiding av digitale terrengmodeller (DTM).
  • vurdere og etablere bruk av dronemåling på samferdsel.
  Kvalifikasjoner
  • relevant utdanning fra høyskole/universitet på minimum bachelornivå  innen geomatikk, landmåling, ingeniørfag eller tilsvarende. Relevant erfaring kan veie opp for manglende formell utdanning.
  • erfaring med NVDB, FKB og SOSI-format.
  • erfaring med landmålingsutstyr og programvare (GNSS og totalstasjon) er en fordel.
  • erfaring med Gemini Terreng (Connect) er en fordel.
  • erfaring fra samferdsels-, utbyggings- eller anleggsprosjekter er en fordel.
  • god muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne på norsk.
Vi tilbyr
  • en nøkkelrolle i skjæringspunktet mellom utbygging, geodata og forvaltning.
  • varierte arbeidsoppgaver med stor grad av selvstendighet.
  • mulighet til å påvirke hvordan geodata forvaltes og brukes i Buskerud fylkeskommune.
  • faglige utfordringer og utviklingsmuligheter innen et viktig fagfelt.
  • lønns- og arbeidsvilkår i henhold til lov- og avtaleverk
  • pensjon i Pensjonskassen for fylkene

Ansettelsesform: Fast ansettelse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Buskerud fylkeskommune ønsker medarbeidere som tar en aktiv, engasjert, reflektert og ansvarlig rolle i organisasjonen vår. Hos oss møtes mennesker med ulik kompetanse- og utdanningsbakgrunn for å skape gode tjenester til våre innbyggere.Buskerud fylkeskommune har ansvar for viktige samfunnsoppgaver som videregående opplæring, kollektivtransport og fylkesveier, tannhelsetjenester, regional planlegging, kultur og kulturminner.Buskerud fylkeskommune er opptatt av mangfold, og vi oppfordrer derfor alle som er kvalifisert i henhold til stillingens krav, til å søke hos oss. Vi tilpasser arbeidsplassen så langt vi har mulighet til det.For ansettelse i skole og tannhelse kreves det politiattest av kandidater som får tilbud om stilling.Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkeres navn vil bli ført opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om å bli unntatt fra denne, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for at unntak skal kunne innvilges, jf. offentleglova § 25. Dersom ønsket om unntak ikke blir tatt til følge, vil søkeren bli varslet før offentliggjøring.

title: Sosiale Media og markedsføringskoordinator - Fortell historien om bedre kjøtt - Stabekk
description:
Under varemerket IOm (Indre Oslo matforedling) produserer vi pølser, pålegg og spekemat i en 100 gammel apotekergård i Bærum.

Dyrevelferd, bærekraft og ekte mat står sentralt for oss. Et slagord som vi liker for å illustrere vår filosofi, er denne: "Spis mindre kjøtt, men bedre kjøtt."

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ønsker oss en viderekommet student eller nylig utdannet markedsfører med betydelig kunnskap om sosiale media som kommunikasjonskanal, og med tilstrekkelig teknisk innsikt. Du skal arbeide nært med vår daglige leder. Du må være skrivefør, og kunne utforme tekster - også til brosjyrer / flyers, etc.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Å produsere innhold, ta bilder og video, og utforme budskap til regelmessig og kontinuerlig profilering av bedriften og produktene våre i sosiale media. Vi anslår omtrent 6 timer pr. uke.

Vi tilbyr

En engasjert person som er interessert i ekte mat, dyrevelferd og bærekraft vil være den rette for oss, og vil kunne bidra betydelig til å utvikle bedriften. Mulighet for større stillingsprosent og fast jobb om salget går bra, og du gjør en god jobb.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Under varemerket IOm (Indre Oslo matforedling) produserer vi pølser, pålegg og spekemat i en 100 gammel apotekergård i Bærum. I 10 år holdt vi til i Storgata i Oslo, inntil plassen ble for liten og tungvint.

Dyevelferd, bærekraft og ekte mat står sentralt for oss. Vi er en håndverksbedrift ikke en industriell produsent. Vi selger halvdelen til delikatessebutikker og restauranter, og den andre halvdelen direkte til forbrukere i nettbutikk (iomat.no) og i et fabrikkutsalg.

title: Kid Mo i Rana søker engasjert og driftig butikkleder
description:
Kid/Hemtex er i dag en av Nordens ledende interiør- og tekstilkjeder, med mer enn 280 fysiske butikker og nettbutikk, representert i Norge, Sverige, Finland og Estland. Vi tilbyr et bredt og inspirerende utvalg av kvalitetsprodukter til gode priser. Hos oss blir du en del av et fremoverlent selskap som ønsker å fortsette å vokse og utvikle seg. Vi verdsetter fellesskap og en prestisjefri kultur, der du som medarbeider får muligheten til å påvirke og bidra i vår utvikling. Våre verdier Kremmerånd, Inspirasjon og Dedikasjon - veileder oss og gjennomsyrer alt vi gjør.

Brenner du for Retail? Har du en kremmer i magen og får du energi av å yte topp service? Elsker du i tillegg interiør, tekstil, møbler og trender? Trives du også med at du får dine 10.000 skritt i løpet av en arbeidsdag, og at en dag aldri er lik den neste? Da er vi i Kid kanskje en perfekt match for deg!

Som butikkleder i Kid skal du sørge for at oppgaver blir utført i tide og er av høy kvalitet. Det gjør du igjennom et tydelig og engasjerende lederskap. Du er opptatt av folk, både av eget team og av kundene våre – og du oppleves derfor som en trygg leder som igjennom gode relasjoner står stødig, selv på dager hvor turtallet er ekstra høyt. Menneskene er vår største styrke, og vi vet at vi vil lykkes om vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø. Du vil få muligheten til å utfordre deg selv som leder, bygge og utvikle ditt team, som sammen kan løfte butikken til nye høyder.

Vi har spurt våre kolleger om hva som er det beste med å jobbe i Kid, og da svarer de:

"Kid har gode verdier og evner å se enkeltindividene"

"Det er et flott konsept og et firma som bryr seg om sine ansatte"

"Arbeidet er veldig variert og gøy!"

"Det er enkelt å lære seg å bli flink i jobben sin og det gir en god mestringsfølelse"

"Det legges til rette for gode fremtidsutsikter og Kid er en trygg arbeidsgiver"

"Kid er folkelig og nedpå, og det liker jeg godt!"

Hva vil være ansvaret ditt?

  • At du gjennom delegering, inkludering og «heiarop» sørger for at teamet ditt får ryggsekken full av mestringsopplevelser
  • At du og teamet ditt skaper en inspirerende butikk med en kundeservice som gjør at kundene opplever det «godt å komme hjem»
  • At du og teamet ditt er dedikerte kremmere, som finner løsninger på utfordringer og elsker tempo og variasjon
  • At du og teamet ditt følger konsept, og leverer høy kvalitet, som igjen gir god måloppnåelse og sunne driftsresultater

Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Har ledererfaring og er glad i folk
  • Trives med å jobbe ut ifra konsept, og det er en styrke om du i tillegg har estetisk sans
  • Trigges av salg og resultater, og har ambisjoner på egne og andres vegne
  • Er «fremme i skoene», tar initiativ og liker at ingen dag er lik en annen

Vi tilbyr:

  • En lederstilling med utviklingsmuligheter
  • Karrieremuligheter hos en av de ledende aktørene innen interiør i norsk detaljhandel
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og bonusordning
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • En spennende jobb med daglige utfordringer
  • En «levende» bransje med store variasjoner, hvor den enkeltes innsats teller

Med en veldreven organisasjon og et godt støtteapparat i ryggen, ligger alt til rette for at du skal lykkes i rollen. Din nærmeste leder er regionleder. Du vil bli del av en sammensveiset gruppe med dyktige butikkledere, i tillegg vil du ha mange hjelpsomme kolleger ved vårt servicekontor i Lier.

NB! Vennligst ikke send søknaden din pr e-post til oss. Kun søknader som sendes via vår rekrutteringsportal vil bli vurdert. Gå inn på karrieresiden vår karriere.kid.no for å sende oss en søknad.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kid Interiør er Nordens største tekstil- og interiørkonsern. Konsernet består av kjedene Kid Interiør med en butikkportefølje av ca 150 butikker i Norge, og Hemtex med ca 140 butikker i Sverige, Finland og Estland. Begge kjedene driver i tillegg sine egne nettbutikker som er i sterk vekst. ...

title: Fastlegevikariat
description:
Vi søkjer deg som vil bli ein del av vårt team.

Sula kommune har ledig fastlegevikariat tilknytt kommunelegekontoret frå 01.02.2027 til 13.03.2028. Det er ein avtale med listetak på 600, men den er ikkje full. Anna tidspkt for oppstart kan avtalast.

Kommunelegekontoret har i dag 11 fastlegar og ein LIS1-lege. Nesten alle fastlegane er spesialistar i allmennmedisin. Ein har også dyktige medarbeidarar i form av helsesekretærar og sjukepleiarar. Kontoret har fokus på godt samarbeid, god kompetanse og tenesteutvikling alt for at både pasientar og medarbeidarar skal trivast på kontoret.Driftsforma er basert på næringsdrift som hovudmodell der legen betaler leige til kommunen for lokaler, utstyr og personell m.m. Fastlegar med driftsavtale får utbetalt basistilskotet og betalar husleige til kommunen berekna etter listetal (8.2-avtale). Ingen av legane har ansvar for generell drift og personalansvar, det er det kommunen som tar seg av.  Kommunelegekontoret har hatt stabil legedekning i lang tid, og det har jevnlig blitt oppretta nye avtalar. Gjennomsnittleg listelengde er ca 900. Fastlegane samarbeidar godt og bistår kvarandre med faglege vurderingar av pasientar. Det er viktig for kommunen å tilby gode arbeidsvilkår tilpassa ulike livssituasjonen for legen.

Ta gjerne kontakt om du ønskjer meir informasjon

Arbeidsoppgåver

  Klinisk praksis på eiga liste, og generell kollegeal fråværsdekning

 Offentlege legeoppgåver kan bli tilplikta, med inntil 7,5 time pr veke, etter nærare avtale med kollegar og kommunen.

 Deltaking i interkommunal legevakt på kveld, natt og helg lokalisert like ved Ålesund sjukehus, legane deltar i vaktordninga.

 Kommunen har organisert daglegevakt, vaktbelastninga blir fordelt på alle legane i kommunen

Kvalifikasjonar

 Søkjar må ha norsk autorisasjon

 LIS1, eller tilsvarande, må vere gjennomført og godkjent

 Andre relevante faglege kvalifikasjonar og relevant erfaring vil bli vurdert, sett i lys av å utfylle den totale kompetansen blant fastlegane i kommunen.

 Fagleg oppdatert på relevant kunnskap

 Må beherske norsk språk godt, både munnleg og skriftlig

 Må ha sertifikat klasse B og kunne disponere bil

 Politiattest

Personlege eigenskapar

 Du er god på kommunikasjon, samarbeid og skapar gode relasjonar til pasientar og kollegaer 

 Du er fleksibel, engasjert og motivert for jobben

 Du har evne til å jobbe i eit hektisk miljø, der ingen veit kva dagen bringer

Det vil bli lagt vekt på personlege eigenskapar og gode samarbeidsevne.

Vi tilbyr

 Kommunen er registrert utdanningsverksemd for ALIS

 Kommunen vil legge til rette for spesialisering i allmennmedisin, LIS3

 Rettleiing og supervisjon frå erfarne fastlegar

 Legekontoret brukar KI generert taleverkty til journalføring.

 Heimekontorordning i samsvar med lokal avtale

 Godt samarbeid mellom fastlegane og administrasjonen i kommunen.

 Å få arbeide i eit velutstyrt og triveleg arbeidsfellesskap med godt kvalifiserte medarbeidarar som har fokus på tenesteutvikling

 Godt tverrfaglig samarbeid med dei andre tenestene i kommunen.

 Gratis parkering

KontaktinformasjonGrethe Øen, Einingsleiar, 93821014, grethe.elise.gjorvad.oen@sula.kommune.no Rim Hammer, Fastlege, rim.hammer@sula.kommune.no Øystein Mjelde Aasen, HTV DNL / Fastlege, øystein.mjelde.aasen@sula.kommune.no ArbeidsstadStadsnesvegen 9b 6030 Langevåg Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Sula kommune Referansenr.: 5202947812 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikar Startdato: 01.02.2027 Sluttdato: 13.03.2028 Søknadsfrist: 22.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sula kommune er opptatt av å utvikle og forbetre tenestene saman med innbyggerane og næringslivet, slik vi kan vere ei trygg og framtidsretta kommune. 

Sula kommune ligg sentralt til på Sunnmøre med Ålesund som næraste nabo. Kommunen har omlag 9800 innbyggjarar, der omlag halvparten bur i kommunesenteret Langevåg. Sula er ein av dei minste og mest folketette kommunane i fylket. Kommunen er vekstkommune med stor aktivitet, rikt kulturliv og har gode høve til å dyrke friluftsliv. Veksten har ført til auke av butikk-, kafe- og næringsverksemder. Det tek 7 minutt med båt over til Ålesund sentrum. Kommunesenteret og Sula rådhus ligg i Langevåg.

title: Commercial Director – Defence and Security
description:
Much of the energy and data Europe depends on travels through cables and pipelines on the seabed. Securing this infrastructure, along with offshore installations, has become a clear priority for defence. DeepOcean has more than 25 years of experience in subsea survey, installation, trenching, inspection, maintenance and repair. We are now setting up a separate defence and security team to offer these services to defence organisations in Norway, the UK, NATO and allied countries.

We are looking for a Commercial Director to lead our sales and bid work in this market. As the team is newly established, you will be starting from scratch.  You will decide which customers to focus on, build the relationships and lead the bids through to signed contracts. You will report to the Director of the DeepOcean defence team and join a small team with real freedom to shape how the business develops. You will need to be hands-on yourself and gradually build the team required to handle the growth in the unit.

The role is based in Norway and involves regular travel to customers, partners and our sites in Norway, the UK and internationally. Applications will be handled confidentially.  

Your key responsibilities:

  • Map the defence market and build our pipeline – Norwegian Armed Forces and Forsvarsmateriell, NATO and NATO agencies, UK MOD and the Royal Navy, allied nations and the major defence primes – and decide where we can realistically win.
  • Build and maintain the relationships that give us access, from programme owners and capability planners to partners and primes, and put the teaming agreements and partnerships in place that let us compete.
  • Lead capture and bids end to end: the bid/no-bid call, the win strategy, shaping the solution with our engineers and operators, pricing it, writing it, submitting it and defending it.
  • Secure our licence to bid – supplier registrations, prequalifications, frameworks and the compliance groundwork a new defence entity needs before anyone will take its offer seriously.
  • Negotiate terms and commercial risk through to contract, then hand the work over cleanly to the delivery organisation.
  • Build the commercial function itself – pipeline reporting, bid process, win/loss discipline – and grow a small commercial and bid team as the business scales.

 

Experience and qualifications:

  • 7–10 years in business development, capture or commercial roles, with significant time spent selling into or working within defence.
  • An active, current network in Norwegian defence (Forsvaret, Forsvarsmateriell, FFI) and/or NATO, UK MOD or allied defence organisations.
  • Practical experience of public and defence procurement – tender requirements, framework competitions, evaluation criteria – and of negotiating commercial terms and risk.
  • A degree in engineering, business or economics, or a military academy background. Strong, directly relevant experience can replace formal qualifications.
  • Eligible for Norwegian and NATO security clearance. You do not need to hold a clearance today – but should be able to receive a clearance when needed.
  • A background in subsea, maritime, offshore or naval work is an advantage.

 

Personal qualifications:

  • You are a self-starter who is comfortable without a playbook, and you would rather build the function than inherit it.
  • You have commercial judgement and the nerve to use it – you know which opportunities to walk away from, and you can make that case internally.
  • You write well and present well, and you hold your own in front of senior military and industry people.
  • You play the long game when it comes to relationships, in a market where decisions can take years.
  • You are resilient and organised, and you can run several bids to fixed deadlines without dropping any of them.
  • You are curious about the technology, enough to explain to a customer what our capability actually does for them.

Our values are important to us, and we are therefore looking for people who identify with them: We ACT with a can-do Attitude. We ACT with the Courage to embrace new challenges, stop unsafe practices, always be compliant and shift boundaries through innovative solutions. And we ACT as one Team.

 

Why will you enjoy working with us?

  • A fast-paced and team-oriented work environment – we have fun at work!
  • Varied challenges, great development opportunities, and the chance to make an impact in a global organization.
  • Favorable travel insurance (including family members), health insurance, and pension plans (including AFP), as well as subsidies for physical activity.
  • Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance, so you can thrive both at work and at home.
  • And for this role in particular: a rare opportunity to build a new business from the ground up, with the resources, track record and engineering depth of an established international subsea company behind you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and workplace. We value inclusion, equality and diversity and encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

DeepOcean is a technology-driven, independent solution provider in the ocean space. We offer companies within oil and gas, offshore renewables, deep sea minerals, and other non-energy niches a full range of services – from surveys, engineering, project management and installation to maintenance and recycling.

Our global team of experts is at the forefront of remote and unmanned operations and digitally-enabled services. Supported by an extensive tool and technology pool, they drive cost-efficient, safe and sustainable operations. DeepOcean has a GO GREEN attitude, continuously looking to make our customers’ operations more sustainable, through reducing both carbon footprint and costs.  

A world-leading ocean services provider, DeepOcean enables the energy transition and sustainable use of ocean resources. People are the heart of our operations. It’s about technology, systems, and processes, but in the end, it is our people that deliver the services.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry, available at Department of Chemistry, theoretical chemistry section.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.03.2027 . The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year maybe considered and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is The Life Science Building at Blindern, Oslo.

Project description

A PhD position is available at the Section for Theoretical Chemistry, Department of Chemistry, University of Oslo, within the project Molecular Atmospheric Chemistry on Alien Worlds (MACAW), funded by the Research Council of Norway.In this project we will employ quantum chemistry methods using high-performance computing (HPC) resources to study chemical reactions, photochemistry, identify spectral signatures for potential detection and elucidate condensation mechanisms for molecules in atmospheres beyond that of contemporary Earth. The project has a particular focus on Sulfur and Chlorine chemistry as well as isotopic fractionation processes.The successful applicant will have freedom to pursue specific research topics within the relatively wide project framework, in coordination with the supervisor. The work is first and foremost computational utilizing electronic structure methods to qualitatively study photochemical and thermal reaction mechanisms, as well as quantify reaction rates, UV-Vis spectra and other molecular properties relevant to studying the role of molecules in planetary atmospheres.

The work has a high degree of international collaboration within the main project supervisors' network currently spanning four continents among seven nations. This is to ensure maximal dissemination and impact of the project results, and thus the project will likely involve more than a usual amount of both hosting international visitors and travel to visit our collaborators.The project work is highly flexible, allowing the successful candidate to structure their own work.This project is an excellent opportunity for a prospective PhD candidate to make original and foundational contributions to the field of planetary atmospheric chemistry, with the potential for leading to groundbreaking discoveries of new molecules or chemical processes on other planets.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physics, nanoscience or related fields. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience in utilizing computational resources and code for simulations of molecular properties
  • Experience with quantum chemistry calculations
  • Experience with scripting or programming (e.g. Python, Bash, Matlab, Fortran), and high-performance computing 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in electronic structure methods, e.g. DFT, coupled cluster or multireference methods
  • Background in chemical kinetics, reaction mechanisms, photochemistry, spectroscopy, transition state theory, atmospheric chemistry and/or physical chemistry
  • Any insights into planetary/exoplanetary science and photochemical atmospheric modeling 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A fundamental drive for scientific research, keenness/eagerness in challenging work with limited repetitiveness which requires continued learning
  • A strong interest in atmospheric, planetary and/or exoplanet science
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of an international, interdisciplinary team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks. The work is very flexible which requires discipline
  • Direct communication skills and excellent collaboration
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

Hylleraas Centre for Quantum Molecular Sciences operates under the aegis of the Department of Chemistry at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The Department of Chemistry  is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. 

The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

title: Facility Technical Sr. Manager
description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Technical Senior Manager, you will lead the technical MEP unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the unit ahead of the start of operations. You will make sure the facility’s electrical, mechanical, cooling, automation and cabling infrastructure is operated, maintained and developed safely and reliably.

 

You will report to the Facility Director and lead through an Associate Facility Technical Manager, shift managers, a project manager, technical specialists and operational support functions. Additionally, you will hold technical authority within the unit.

 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the unit. Establish a structured training programme and knowledge transfer to the full technical operations team.
  • Lead technical operations around the clock, ensure adequate staffing and the right mix of competencies across all shifts to support 24/7 operations.
  • Manage preventive and corrective maintenance, and lead the technical response and fault-finding during critical incidents.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning and handover of technical installations together with Nscale. Lead the development and implementation of technical operating procedures (SOP/MOP/EOP) and governance structures, and establish technical supplier agreements.
  • Ensure safe working methods and full HSE compliance, and manage technical suppliers and contractors on quality, documentation, performance and cost.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from data centres, hyperscale or HPC facilities. You may also come from technical or production leadership in continuous process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, power generation, offshore, maritime operations or technical defence environments. A career path from an electrical, automation or mechanical specialist role into technical or maintenance leadership is particularly valuable.

You enjoy developing people, share knowledge patiently and build ownership of procedures. You drive continuous improvement through structured processes, not by departing from them.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Structured and systematic, thriving where structures, roles and requirements are clearly defined.
  • Acts in compliance with procedures, standards and regulatory requirements, and holds others to the same standard.
  • Resilient under pressure, building relationships of trust and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid experience leading the operation and maintenance of complex electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with the technical depth to challenge specialists and suppliers.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, preferably with both day and shift teams.
  • Experience with procedures, work permits, safe isolation, change management and supplier management. Experience from testing, commissioning and handover is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. A degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering, or equivalent documented engineering background, is preferred.

 

What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the technical organisation, procedures and training from the ground up, and to bring Kvandal South’s technical systems into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

title: Arbeidsleder - Stillas bransjen
description:
Vi ser etter en arbeidsleder som kan lede vårt team og sikre effektiv og sikker gjennomføring av prosjektene våre. Vi er en ledende aktør innen stillas bygging, og vi søker en dyktig arbeidende formann for å styrke vårt team i Møre og Romsdal. Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe på spennende prosjekter, samtidig som du leder et kompetent team.

Hva vi ser etter

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Ansvarsfull og selvstendig.

  • Gode organisatoriske ferdigheter.

  • Evne til å motivere og veilede teammedlemmer.

  • Løsningsorientert og trygg i utfordrende situasjoner.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Lede og organisere stillasbygging på byggeplasser.

  • Sikre at prosjektene gjennomføres i henhold til sikkerhetskrav og forskrifter.

  • Koordinere arbeidsteamet og sørge for effektiv ressursbruk.

  • Utføre risikovurdering og sørge for sikkerheten på byggeplassen.

  • Kommunisere med prosjektledelse og kunder.

  • Delta aktivt i det praktiske stillasarbeidet.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Må ha godkjent sertifisering i stillasarbeid enten med fagbrev eller som godkjent stillasmontører etter § 17-4.

  • Minimum 5 års erfaring som arbeidende formann eller i relevant rolle.

  • Gode lederegenskaper og erfaring med teamledelse.

  • God forståelse for sikkerhet og risikovurdering.

  • Førerkort for bil (fordel med BE og CE) og gjerne truckførerbevis.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn.

  • Gode arbeidsforhold i et støttende arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.

  • Fast ansettelse med forsikringsordninger og pensjonsavtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Fjord Stillas As er et selskap som driver med utleie og montering av stillas, samt opplæring innenfor stillas faget. Fjord Stillas As henvender seg i all hovedsak mot proffmarkedet. Vi har hatt en stor del av vår virksomhet rettet mot privat og forskjellige industrier, hvor vi har stillas ansvar for prosjektledelse, montering og stillas utstyr. Vi har også mye aktivitet mot bygg og anleggsbransjen. Utleie parken består av fasade og spirstillas i aluminium, som vi monterer og leier ut over hele Møre og Romsdal. Fjord Stillas As har 8 egne montører og leier inn ekstra montører ved behov.

title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 16.11.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

title: PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics, available at the Department of Mathematics, as part of QSTAR – Centre for quantum computing and applications.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.04.2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Mathematics/QSTAR at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description

The position is affiliated with QSTAR - Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications. QSTAR is a five-year research centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (project number 361617) and hosted and led by SINTEF. It brings together researchers at SINTEF, UiO, NTNU, OsloMet and Simula Research Laboratory, with international partners at the University of Copenhagen and RISE in Sweden.

The centre connects four research work packages: fault tolerance and error correction; compilation and Hamiltonian engineering; foundations of quantum algorithms; and quantum algorithms for applications. Together, they address how quantum information can be protected, how algorithms can be implemented, and where quantum computation may offer advantages, particularly in chemistry and optimisation.

PhD candidates become part of a research community spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry and optimisation. The centre’s programme includes seminars, PhD schools, annual retreats and conferences, alongside opportunities for international exchange and collaboration across partner institutions.

Learn more about the centre’s research, people and activities on the QSTAR website

The position is advertised within work package 1 “Fault-tolerance and error correction”. More specifically, the successful candidate will work on theoretical questions in one of the following two projects.

The first project studies questions in the fields of quantum groups and tensor categories, with a particular focus on possible applications to fault-tolerant quantum computation through the paradigm of topological quantum computation. We also aim to develop and extend connections between these fields and quantum information science in a broad sense, beyond fault-tolerance.

The second project is concerned with employing methods of group theory, representation theory and operator algebras to construct new families of quantum codes with improved performance and novel features. Another core task in the second project will be to study various families of quantum channels from the perspective of quantifying noise.

The PhD Fellow will join the Operator Algebra group in Section 6 at the Department of Mathematics, where the work will be conducted in close collaboration with other members of the QSTAR project.

The PhD Fellow will:

  • Look for application of the theory of tensor category and quantum groups to problems related to topological quantum computation.
  • Look for connections between quantum information theory and noncommutative geometry through studying quantum channels as noise models.
  • Work in close collaboration with researchers in operator algebras and quantum information theory.
  • Join a research group with broad expertise in mathematics, quantum chemistry, and theoretical physics.
What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

  • Relevant experience in operator algebras, representation theory, or quantum information theory
  • For applicants with an MSc in Physics, a solid mathematical component in their education is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 31.03.2027 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 10.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

Experience from restaurants og hotel environments does not meet the requirements for these positions.

Candidates currently living in Western Norway or Northern Norway are encouraged to apply, especially if they have experience from established seafood processing plants.
