You’ll find a friendly, supportive environment that celebrates creativity, growth, and a shared passion for building world‑class real‑time audio algorithm experiences.Your Impact    Design, implement, and optimize VoIP audio algorithms—including adaptive jitter buffers, packet loss concealment, and codec pipelines—based on product requirements.    Perform peer code reviews and automate development workflows and quality gates.    Participate in agile ceremonies including daily stand‑ups, planning, releases, and retrospectives.    Collaborate across teams to broaden technical and soft skills through training and mentoring.Minimum Qualifications:    MSc (or equivalent) in Software Engineering or a related field.    Hands-on experience developing VoIP or real‑time audio algorithms (e.g., adaptive jitter buffer, packet loss concealment, codec integration) in production systems.    Proficiency in C/C++ with strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.    Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real‑time applications.    Professional verbal and written communication skills in English.    Uses AI responsibly to accelerate development.    Critically reviews AI-generated code before using it.Preferred Qualifications:    Experience applying AI/ML to audio algorithm development or optimization in production voice systems.    Experience evaluating and tuning audio algorithms using objective metrics (e.g., POLQA, PESQ) and subjective listening tests.    Experience with close‑to‑real‑time systems and performance‑sensitive code paths.    Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.    Collaborative, friendly, and self‑directed; eager to learn and share knowledge.    Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.Why Cisco? We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Product Software Engineer
description: Hej Product Software Engineer,Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions? With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Product Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before. Your new job IKEA Range Core is part of the Technology area, working with critical digital products that enable the functioning of IKEA. You’ll be part of IKEA of Sweden and the Range Core Engineering organization within Range Operations. The Range Core Area focuses on building attractive, consistent, and efficient ways of working for pre-product development, our retailers and our suppliers. Our mission is to create a strong foundation for IKEA’s labelling systems, enabling seamless use across the entire value chain. We’re looking for a Product Software Engineer who wants to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to build reliable digital products that contribute to a better everyday life for the many people. You will work within Labels and Marking Management domain developing and operating software while helping govern the product architecture and keeping the technical solution coherent across the product and its closest dependencies. You will lead through expertise, coach other engineers and collaborate with Software Engineering Leaders to achieve all outcomes within the Labels domain. On a typical day, you will:     Develop, test, deploy and maintain software for Label and Marking Management.     Govern and evolve the architecture for Label and Marking Management Domain, ensuring coherence, robustness, security, interoperability and appropriate reuse.     Apply, promote and teach modern software engineering practices, including continuous integration and delivery, automated testing and observability.     Deliver secure, maintainable and production-ready code aligned with agreed architecture, standards, planning and budget.     Provide technical direction and mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.     Collaborate across products/ teams to manage dependencies and balance product-specific needs with common solutions.     Explore new technologies and create proposals or prototypes that improve architecture, productivity or user experience.     Maintain relevant technical documentation and contribute to indicators that help the team understand delivery and product health. What we’d like you to bring to the table The role as Product Software Engineer requires you to:     Have about 7+ years' experience in software engineering, including strong hands-on experience with RESTful APIs, SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL), including data modelling, complex queries, performance optimization, and stored procedures, or front-end development (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) and at least one modern framework (React, Angular, or Vue).     Have experience governing or significantly influencing digital product architecture, using relevant architecture concepts or frameworks.     Be a technical coach to the team where you help uplift the team in terms of technical competence.     Ability to facilitate technical discussions, remove blockers, and support team cohesion and productivity.     Have broad knowledge of modern engineering practices, secure development, testing, CI/CD, observability and DevOps ways of working.     Strong interpersonal skills, including active listening, guiding discussions, mediating conflicts, and supporting team development.     Have proven ability to develop high-quality, maintainable code while making sound technical and architectural trade-offs.     Have experience leading and mentoring engineers through influence rather than formal people-management responsibility.     Communicate clearly and collaborate across products, functions, organisational levels and cultural backgrounds.     Be curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating uncertainty while balancing delivery, user value, quality and long-term product health. It’s a plus if you also:     Have worked across several connected products, platforms or technology domains and managed complex technical dependencies.     Have experience with prototyping, technical discovery, engineering metrics or improving standards and ways of working at scale. Be yourself, a Product Software Engineer, and more! Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. We welcome your application Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 13th of November. This position is based in Malmö. We believe that your presence with the team and working most of the time in the workplace is important.   Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Hiring Manager manasa.konda@inter.ikea.com or the Recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com. At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.

title: ECAD Tool Owner / EPLAN Specialist
description: ECAD Tool Owner / EPLAN Specialist for a Global Engineering Environment in LinköpingDescriptionWe are looking for a consultant to take overall responsibility for EPLAN within an international, technology-focused organisation. The assignment combines an understanding of electrical design with application management, user support and the development of working practices. You do not need to know every aspect from day one, but you should understand EPLAN and be able to drive initiatives in collaboration with users, IT and other technical teams.About the assignmentAs ECAD Tool Owner, you will have global responsibility for managing and further developing the EPLAN environment. The role combines technical and coordination responsibilities: gathering business requirements, leading discussions with key users and ensuring that tools, guidelines and integrations evolve in a structured way.A key part of the assignment is the integration between EPLAN and Teamcenter via XPLM. You will take the lead on project activities related to this integration, including planning user testing and introducing the solution to different user groups. An electrical designer already provides backup support for administration and ongoing project activities, creating a solid foundation for handover and collaboration.Your responsibilities will include:    Acting as the global administrator and Tool Owner for EPLAN.    Leading and developing the organisation’s key user community.    Gathering requirements, improvement suggestions and user feedback.    Planning and implementing EPLAN updates.    Creating and maintaining guidelines and shared working practices.    Managing licences and related application management activities.    Taking responsibility for the EPLAN infrastructure in collaboration with IT.    Supporting key users and helping resolve issues efficiently.    Taking ownership of the XPLM interface between EPLAN and Teamcenter.    Leading projects related to the further development and rollout of the integration.    Planning user testing and introducing new solutions to the relevant users.Your profileYou have worked in electrical design and have practical experience with EPLAN. Your background may include roles such as electrical designer, EPLAN administrator, application specialist, CAD/ECAD coordinator or application manager. What matters most is that you understand users’ day-to-day work and can take clear ownership of tool-related matters.You should be comfortable gathering requirements, coordinating activities and driving initiatives forward with multiple stakeholders. The role suits someone who is structured, communicative and solution-oriented, with the ability to move between technical details and a broader application management perspective.Mandatory requirements    Experience in electrical design.    Practical experience with EPLAN.    Ability to gather requirements and plan and drive activities.    Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written.Desirable qualifications    Experience in EPLAN administration or application management.    Experience with Teamcenter.    Experience with XPLM or similar integrations between ECAD and PLM systems.    Experience with system upgrades, user testing or rollouts to multiple user groups.    Experience leading key user networks or working in an international organisation.Assignment detailsAssignment type: Consultancy assignmentWorkload: Full-time, 100%Location: Linköping, on-siteStart date: As soon as possibleAssignment duration: Six-month periodsExtension: Good prospects for extensionLanguage: Spoken and written English requiredWhy this assignment is interestingThis role offers significant practical influence over a core engineering design tool within a global technology organisation. You will work closely with electrical design teams, users and IT while driving an important integration between ECAD and PLM. The combination of technical depth, international collaboration and clear ownership makes this assignment particularly relevant for a consultant looking to move from a dedicated design role into tool ownership and technical application management.

title: Lead Developer
description: Looking for a workplace for the future?We are looking for a Lead developer for our Online Sales team, enabling all digital sales journeys on Telenor.se. You will guide and lead highly skilled developers operating in a complex landscape; balancing team growth, AI adoption, technical evolution, and customer experience improvements. We are looking for someone who holds a deep conceptual understanding of frontend software development, but you will also be expected to do hands-on work yourself. We believe the correct person for this role and team is both a leader, mentor and a doer.How you’ll make a difference with us    Leadership: You will be accountable for the technical excellence of the team, including code quality. However, there are many ways to lead and at Telenor we promote strength-based leadership and servant leadership.     Team Management & Growth: At Telenor we believe we are Better Together. You're expected to help your colleagues learn and grow, for example through individual feedback, mentoring and pair programming.     Stability & reliability: Telenor provides services that are vital for our society. Because of this an important responsibility for this role to ensure stable, resilient and secure platforms.     In-team collaboration: You'll be one of the informal leaders of the team, together with the Agile Team Lead and the Product Owner, whom you'll be expected to collaborate closely with.     Cross-team collaboration: You'll work closely with architects, UX, content creators and other development teams. Are you the one we’re looking for?We are looking for someone comfortable working with most of our current technologies, who can work within our architectural principles and help evolve them through thoughtful discussion and practical experience. We are looking for someone familiar with the following technologies.Frontend Development    Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript and frontend frameworks (e.g. Vue).     Microfrontend architectures and components patterns.     Design Systems, component libraries.    Responsive design and browser compatibility. Backend Development    Strong expertise in .NET/C# web application development.     Third-party system integrations (REST APIs and GraphQL).     Headless CMS architecture (Contentful).  Testing & Quality    TDD and quality-first development.     Clean code, maintainability and engineering best practices. Cloud, DevOps & Observability     Cloud platforms (AWS).     Distributed caching strategies (Redis).     CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).     Observability and performance analysis (ELK, Splunk, Elastic APM). Accessibility     WCAG, semantic HTML and inclusive design.     Accessibility testing and compliance. Security    Security best practices.     Secure coding and privacy by design. Good-to-have    E-commerce and digital sales flows.    Feature management and experimentation platforms.     AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code). Our promise to you! We are better together. Here, you’ll join an inclusive, family-like culture where shared values and empowering leadership build trust, confidence, and mutual support.We support relationships and societies. Telenor serves society by creating value for millions daily, putting customers and human relationships first.We make room for life. Work remotely up to two days a week when your role allows, and collaborate at the office otherwise. Enjoy two extra days off yearly, flexible hours, and benefits for every life stage, including collective agreements, pensions, wellness allowances, and tailored insurance.Move your career forward. Your growth is central to our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours yearly to learning through Telenor Academy and other initiatives, helping you build expertise, explore new areas, and advance your career across the Nordics.Apply today!At Telenor we offer an environment with a high pace of change, great colleagues and lots of opportunities for learning and growth. Apply now!If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Jakob Grefbäck at jakob.grefback@telenor.se . title: Process Engineer
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you'll doRight now, we are looking for a Process Engineer – Direct Reduction for our Green Iron Operations. The team is responsible for optimizing process performance, supporting safe and stable operations, and driving continuous improvements across our hydrogen production and direct reduction plants.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very few silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Provide day-to-day process engineering support to ensure safe, stable, and efficient plant operations.    Monitor plant performance, troubleshoot process upsets, and lead root cause analyses to improve reliability and operational excellence.    Optimize process performance through process modelling, heat and mass balances, debottlenecking, and energy efficiency initiatives.    Support direct reduction operations during commissioning, start-ups, shutdowns, and operational changes.    Review and develop engineering documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, process calculations, SOPs, and process control strategies.    Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, and OEM partners to improve process performance and implement engineering solutions.    Drive continuous improvement projects, monitor production KPIs, and prepare technical reports to support data-driven decision-making.    Promote safe operations by supporting process safety activities, hydrogen safety standards, PTW/LOTO compliance, and technical training.What you'll bringYou're curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You're not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking—and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we'd like to see that you bring:    A degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.    Solid process engineering experience from an operating, commercial-scale Direct Reduction plant.    Experience supporting commissioning, start-ups, process optimization, or operational improvements in an industrial setting.    A strong understanding of process engineering fundamentals, with the ability to analyse complex systems and turn insights into practical solutions.    Experience with hydrogen production is a plus. Curiosity about the hydrogen process and a willingness to learn are important.    Confidence working across disciplines and collaborating with Operations, Maintenance, Automation, Engineering, and external partners to achieve shared goals.    A proactive, structured, and safety-first approach, with a continuous improvement mindset.    Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden SiteOur Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden Video

title: DCEO Engr 3
description: DescriptionAWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity. Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value. Key job responsibilities You will also be involved in: o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support. o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators. o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment. o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary. o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems. In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!A day in the lifeDay to day activities for this role include; o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center. o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained. o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works. o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties. o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover. o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development. o Event response and drill participation. About the teamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS?Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Inclusive Team CultureHere at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life BalanceWe value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.Basic Qualifications- Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience- 2+ years of relevant work experience- Strong English verbal and written communication skillsPreferred Qualifications- Experience in data center engineeringAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Hotellchef

Du kommer vara spindeln i nätet påplats och ansvara för den dagliga verksamheten.Arbetsuppgifter:    Leda personal, bygga ledningsteamet samt kulturen för hela personalstyrkan.    Driva, följa upp och ansvara för försäljningen på hela hotellet och utveckla strategier för merförsäljning och ökad omsättning.    Kommunikation och veckomöten, löpande kommunikation med ledningsgruppen och personal.    Ansvara för servicekvalitet och säkerställa en exceptionell gästupplevelse genom att optimera arbetsflöden och rutiner    Ansvara för schemaläggning, rekrytering, semesterplanering.    Planera, leda och driva försäljningen för event.    Utveckla och implementera rutiner.Kvalifikationer·     Erfarenhet från att självständigt drivit och ansvarat för hotell och konferens.·     Ansvara för den övergripande kundkommunikationen.·     Flera års erfarenhet som ledare med bevisad förmåga av att bygga starka team.·     Vana av att jobba med Property management system (PMS) och bordsbokningssystem.    Viktigt med affärsmässighet och helhetsperspektiv på hotell och restaurang.    Som person är du drivande och kommunikativ med en stor förståelse för företagande och entreprenörskap. Tjänsten är tillsvidare med 6 månaders provanställning.Heltid på rullande schema inklusive kvällar/helger.Fast grundlön

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: MAJORITY is a groundbreaking all-in-one digital financial service app that includes an FDIC-insured account, Visa® Prepaid card, money remittance, and international calling. We are built for migrants, by migrants.Global migration is a 21st-century reality. Whether people are following their dreams, love or new experiences, more and more of us are leaning towards new environments. business.Information \& Records Management Specialist============================================Prestigious company in the banking sector**Description*** Serve as a key point of contact for business stakeholders on day\-to\-day information management matters, translating business requirements into practical solutions and escalating complex issues when necessary.* Support the effective management practices across the organisation, including document control, records management, classification, version management, and retention requirements.* Assist in the implementation and maintenance of capabilities.* Prepare and maintain reports and dashboards on information management performance, compliance, adoption levels, risks, and improvement initiatives.* Identify opportunities to improve information management processes and support the implementation of sustainable and efficient ways of working.* Assist in change and transformation initiatives through requirements gathering, process documentation, user communication, testing coordination, and implementation support.* Advise stakeholders on information management policies, standards, and best practices, while delivering awareness description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Softwareingenieur - Modernisierung (m/w/d)---Senior Softwareingenieur \- Modernisierung (m/w/d)================================================== **Unternehmensbeschreibung**   **Gemeinsam mit 7\.400 Kolleg:innen weltweit sind wir der strategische Partner der Pharma\- und Lebensmittelindustrie für Prozess\- und Verpackungstechnik. Mit reibungslosen Prozessen, innovativen Technologien und nachhaltigen Lösungen helfen wir unseren Kunden, ihre Ziele zu erreichen. Auch Deine Lieblingsschokolade und Snacks werden mit unserer Hilfe nachhaltig verpackt.**Die Syntegon Packaging Systems AG in Beringen (SH) ist ein Unternehmen der Syntegon\-Gruppe und führend im Bereich der Herstellung von Verpackungsmaschinen und Handlingsystemen. Mit rund 900 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern realisieren wir innovative, kundenspezifische Verpackungslösungen im Hochleistungsbereich für die Nahrungsmittelindustrie. **Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!**   **Stellenbeschreibung**  In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion arbeitest du als Teil eines interdisziplinären Projektteams an Modernisierungsprojekten unserer Verpackungssysteme. Neben der technischen Bearbeitung eigener Projekte übernimmst du die fachliche Führung und technische Koordination des Software\- und Hardwareteams im Bereich Modernisierung. Damit leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Erfolg von Syntegon und unserer Kunden.* Du bearbeitest und betreust eigenverantwortlich die technische Seite von Modernisierungsprojekten in Software und Hardware.* Des Weiteren entwickelst du optimale technische Lösungen für individuelle Kundenanforderungen. Dies umfasst die Konzepterstellung, Umsetzung, Remote\-Unterstützung bei der Inbetriebnahme sowie die technische Dokumentation.* Du programmierst Steuerungen und Antriebssysteme mit Rockwell CLX unter Berücksichtigung unterschiedlicher Softwarekonzepte und Maschinengenerationen.* Darüber hinaus passt du elektrische Schemata in E3 an und nimmst erforderliche Änderungen an HMI\-Systemen vor.* Du übernimmst die fachliche Führung des Elektro\-/Softwareengineerings im Bereich Modernisierung und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für technische Fragen, Konzepte und Standards.* Zudem koordinierst du technische Themen im Team, unterstützt bei der Priorisierung von Aufgaben und sorgst für eine einheitliche sowie qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung unserer Lösungen.* Du begleitest und unterstützt Mitarbeitende bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen und förderst den fachlichen Austausch im Team.* Ausserdem arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Elektro\-, Software\- und Hardwareengineering, Projektmanagement, mechanischer Konstruktion, Montage und Inbetriebsetzung zusammen.* Du vertrittst die technischen Interessen des Elektro\-/Softwareengineerings in interdisziplinären Abstimmungen und unterstützt unsere Aussendienstmitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragestellungen mit Endkunden.* Bei anspruchsvollen Modernisierungsprojekten übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.   **Qualifikationen**  * Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im technischen Bereich, beispielsweise in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder Systemtechnik.* Des Weiteren bringst du mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Sondermaschinenbau oder in einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld mit.* Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Rockwell Automation, insbesondere CLX, sowie in Elektro\-CAD\-Systemen wie EPLAN oder E3\. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit HMI\-Systemen wie Zenon und Galileo. Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von Siemens\-Steuerungen sind von Vorteil.* Zudem konntest du bereits technische Verantwortung in Projekten, bei der Begleitung von Mitarbeitenden oder bei der Weiterentwicklung von Standards übernehmen.* Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte technische Entscheidungsfähigkeit und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge adressatengerecht und verständlich vermitteln.* Darüber hinaus arbeitest du strukturiert, selbständig und leistungsorientiert. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung und bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein.* Deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten, dein vernetztes Denken sowie deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung zeichnen dich aus.* Du bist ein Teamplayer und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Fachbereiche zielgerichtet zusammenzubringen.* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.   **Zusätzliche Informationen**  Start: sofort oder nach Vereinbarung  Pensum: 100%  Unbefristete Anstellung  Arbeitsort: BeringenBei dieser Stelle arbeiten wir **nicht** mit Personalvermittlern zusammen! **Benefits:*** Bei uns erwarten dich flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle für eine ausgewogene Work\-Life\-Balance \- Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag in einer 40\-Stunden\-Woche.* Freue dich auf eine erstklassige Verpflegung in unserem Restaurant mit vielfältiger Auswahl an gesunden Ernährungsangeboten. title: Gärtner/in / Hauswart/in (80-100%)
description: Die Wolf Treuhand AG mit Sitz in Grüningen ist ein modernes, regional verankertes Unternehmen. Gepflegte Grünanlagen sind dir genauso wichtig wie gut unterhaltene Liegenschaften – und du packst gerne dort an, wo gerade etwas zu tun ist?**Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen.**Für die Pflege und den Unterhalt der durch uns betreuten Liegenschaften und Aussenanlagen suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit gärtnerischem Fachwissen, handwerklichem Geschick und Freude an einem vielseitigen Arbeitsalltag.**Dein Revier:**Der Schwerpunkt deiner Tätigkeit liegt in der Pflege und Gestaltung der Grün\- und Aussenanlagen diverser Liegenschaften im Zürcher Oberland. Dazu gehören unter anderem:* Pflege von Grünflächen, Pflanzen, Rabatten, Hecken und Gehölzen* Saisonale Garten\- und Umgebungsarbeiten* Rückschnitt, Pflanzarbeiten und allgemeine Pflegearbeiten* Selbständige Planung und Organisation der anfallenden Gartenarbeiten* Sicherstellen eines gepflegten Erscheinungsbildes unserer Liegenschaften und Aussenbereiche**Doch bei uns endet die Arbeit nicht am Gartenzaun.**Du übernimmst auch Hauswartungs\- und Unterhaltsarbeiten. Dabei bildest du gemeinsam mit unserem bestehenden Hauswart ein eingespieltes Unterhaltsteam. Ihr unterstützt euch gegenseitig, teilt die anfallenden Arbeiten sinnvoll auf und vertretet euch bei Abwesenheiten.Das macht die Stelle besonders abwechslungsreich: Du arbeitest im Grünen, kümmerst dich um Gebäude und Umgebung, bist handwerklich tätig und hast regelmässig Kontakt mit Mietern, Handwerkern und weiteren Ansprechpartnern.**Was du mitbringst:*** Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gärtner/in EFZ oder Hauswart/in mit eidg. FA oder langjährige praktische Erfahrung im Gartenunterhalt* Freude an selbständigem und praktischem Arbeiten* Handwerkliches Geschick, technisches Verständnis und eine exakte Arbeitsweise* Zuverlässige, unkomplizierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit* Bereitschaft, neben Gartenarbeiten auch Aufgaben in der Hauswartung zu übernehmen, Neues zu lernen und unsere Hauswartungsabteilung aktiv mitzugestalten* Körperliche Belastbarkeit und Freude an der Arbeit im Freien* Freundliches Auftreten und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten* Teamgeist – denn auch wenn du vieles selbständig erledigst, bildet ihr gemeinsam ein starkes Hauswartungs\- und Unterhaltsteam* Gute Deutschkenntnisse* Führerausweis Kat. B**Was dich bei uns erwartet:**Bei uns findest du keine anonyme Grossorganisation und keinen eintönigen Arbeitsalltag, sondern ein motiviertes und kollegiales Team mit persönlichen und transparenten Umgangsformen.Dich erwartet eine vielseitige Stelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, bei der du deine gärtnerischen Fähigkeiten einbringen und gleichzeitig dein handwerkliches Können einsetzen und erweitern kannst. title: Bewirtschafter:in Stockwerkeigentum - für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand
description: Pensioniert mit Mandat? Ihre Erfahrung im Stockwerkeigentum ist gefragt.**Bewirtschafter/in Stockwerkeigentum – für erfahrene Profis im Ruhestand**Sie haben Eigentümergemeinschaften durch hitzige Versammlungen geführt, Sanierungen über die Ziellinie gebracht und Erneuerungsfonds aufgebaut, die heute noch tragen. Diese Erfahrung lässt sich in keinem Kurs lernen. Sie ist das Ergebnis jahrzehntelanger Praxis – und genau darauf setzen wir.Zusammen mit uns bleiben Sie am Ball – so viel und so oft, wie Sie möchten. Keine grossen Portfolios, kein Pflichtprogramm. Sondern einzelne Stockwerkeigentümergemeinschaften, die Sie mit Ihrer ganzen Erfahrung und in Ihrem Tempo begleiten.ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG ist eine Boutique\-Immobilienbewirtschafterin mit Hauptsitz in Küssnacht am Rigi und einem Standort in Pfäffikon SZ – spezialisiert auf Stockwerkeigentum in der Innerschweiz. Im Generationenwechsel erneuern wir unsere digitale und prozessuale Basis mit Augenmass und entwickeln uns weiter – werden Sie ein Teil davon.Ihr Wirkungsfeld* Sie betreuen einzelne, ausgewählte Stockwerkeigentümergemeinschaften im Kanton Schwyz. Wo Sie tätig werden, besprechen wir gemeinsam.* Sie bereiten Eigentümerversammlungen vor, leiten sie mit Ruhe und Souveränität und begleiten die Umsetzung von gefassten Beschlüssen.* Sie begleiten Unterhalt und Sanierungen, beraten zum Erneuerungsfonds und stehen den Verwaltungsausschüssen als kompetente Ansprechperson zur Seite.* Sie geben Ihr Know\-how an unsere junge Generation von Bewirtschafterinnen und Bewirtschaftern weiter – im gemeinsamen Mandat, an der Versammlung und im täglichen Austausch.* Sie bringen Ihre Sichtweise bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe und Arbeitsmittel ein. Denn Sie wissen aus Erfahrung, was sich in der Praxis bewährt.Was Sie mitbringen* Langjährige Erfahrung in der Bewirtschaftung von Stockwerkeigentum* Sicherheit in Versammlungsführung, Reglementen und Stockwerkeigentumsrecht* Gelassenheit, wenn es emotional wird, und das Geschick, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen* Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen und junge Kolleginnen und Kollegen in ihrer Entwicklung zu begleiten* Offenheit für neue Arbeitsweisen und digitale Hilfsmittel. Bei der Einarbeitung unterstützen wir Sie selbstverständlich.Was wir bieten* **Freiheit in der Zeiteinteilung:** Sie gestalten Ihr Arbeitspensum flexibel und stimmen Ihre Einsätze auf Ihre persönlichen Bedürfnisse und auf die Anforderungen der Eigentümergemeinschaften ab.* **Unsere Infrastruktur, Ihr Rückhalt:**Arbeitssysteme, Vorlagen und ein Team im Hintergrund – Sie müssen nichts selbst aufbauen. Wir richten Ihnen alle Zugänge ein und begleiten Sie persönlich beim Einstieg.* **Homeoffice und Büro:** Sie arbeiten von zu Hause aus und sind bei Bedarf in unseren Büros jederzeit willkommen.* **Ferien ohne schlechtes Gewissen:** Ihre Stellvertretung ist im Team geregelt – auch wenn Sie einmal mehrere Wochen unterwegs sind.* **Ihre Erfahrung zählt:** Wir hören auf Sie. Ihre Ideen und Ihr Urteil fliessen in unsere Arbeit ein.* **Weitergeben, was bleibt:** Sie prägen die nächste Generation der Bewirtschaftung bei ANMAT und sorgen dafür, dass wertvolle Erfahrung und Praxiswissen erhalten bleiben.* **Teil von etwas Neuem:** Gestalten Sie mit, was aus ANMAT im Generationenwechsel wird.* **Faire Konditionen:** Teilzeitanstellung oder Mandat auf Stundenbasis – gut vereinbar als Nebenerwerb neben der Rente. Wir finden die Arbeitsform, die zu Ihrer Situation passt. Ihre Fahrspesen vergüten wir.**Klingt nach Ihnen?**Ein Lebenslauf genügt – oder rufen Sie uns einfach unter an. Ein erstes Gespräch ist bei uns persönlich, offen und unkompliziert. Gerne auch bei einem Kaffee.**Marco Kissling, CEO**  ANMAT ImmoTreuhand AG · Bahnhofstrasse 57 · 6403 Küssnacht am Rigij4id10463203jm j4it1044jm j4iy26jm

title: Auditeur ou Auditrice interne - 100%
description: Ref 2588455 \\\| Date: 31 Oct 2026 !\[HUG - Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève\]( ) Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant\[ici\](\< \>). La \[Direction de l'audit interne\](\< \>)(DAI) remplit deux catégories de missions : les missions d'assurance (missions d'audit) et les missions de conseil. Dans le cadre de sesmissions d'assurance, laDirection de l'audit interne fournit au Comité d'audit un rapport d'audit incluant une évaluation objective sur une entité, un processus, un système ou d'autres domaines en vue de formuler une opinion ou des conclusions. Elle apporte de la valeur ajoutée à l'Institution en prenant en compte la stratégie, les objectifs et les risques, propose des moyens d'améliorer les processus de gouvernance, de management des risques et de contrôle, et fournit avec objectivité une assurance pertinente. L'étendue et la nature de l'exécution des travaux sont déterminées par cette direction. Lesmissions de conseilont pour objectif d'améliorer le fonctionnement des HUG. Elles concernent les processus de gouvernance de l'institution, de management des risques et de contrôle interne. Lors de la réalisation d'une mission de conseil, l'auditeur ou l'auditrice interne fait preuve d'objectivité et n'assume aucune responsabilité managériale dans l'activité concernée ni n'interfère avec les prérogatives de celle\\-ci. Rattachée à la présidence du Conseil d'administration, en sa qualité de présidence du Comité d'audit, laDirection de l'audit interne est responsable de l'établissement des politiques d'audit interne, de la définition et du contenu général de ses activités d'audit et de conseil. Elle procède à la planification annuelle des missions d'audit, dont elle requiert l'approbation du Comité d'audit, de leur mise œuvre et de la coordination des travaux relatifs à ces missions et aux missions spécifiques décidées par le Comité d'audit ou avec son aval. Elle s'assure de la réalisation d'audits indépendants et systématiques des processus pour évaluer leur efficacité au vu des objectifs économiques et des risques. Elle informe régulièrement le Comité d'audit de l'avancement des audits en cours en fonction des délais prévus. La Direction de l'audit interne établit le rapport annuel d'activité qui est remis au Comité d'audit puis, après examen et approbation, communiqué au Conseil d'administration. Elle coordonne l'activité de management des risques et du système de contrôle interne dont la mise en place opérationnelle incombe aux référents et aux référentes des départements et directions. Auditeur ou Auditrice interne \\- 100% La DAI recherche un ou une auditrice interne pour compléter son équipe composée de 6 auditeurs et auditrices internes. Dans ce cadre, vous avez comme principales missions de planifier, conduire et documenter les missions d'audit selon la méthodologie définie. Vous identifiez et analysez les risques et vous évaluez le système de contrôle interne mis en place par les HUG pour les limiter. Vous rédigez des rapports d'audit pertinents, clairs et succincts avec des recommandations apportant une valeur ajoutée puis vous assurez un suivi des recommandations émises. Vous informez régulièrement le Directeur de la DAI sur le déroulement de vos activités et les faits importants constatés. Vous présentez clairement et succinctement les rapports et constatations au Directeur de la DAI ainsi qu'aux responsables des domaines audités. Par ailleurs, vous êtes une personne référente à l'interne pour toute question, information, documentation liée aux procédures et directives institutionnelles ainsi qu'au cadre légal cantonal ou fédéral. Enfin, vous contribuez à la simplification des processus internes en faisant valoir l'intelligence collective. Vous avez un intérêt marqué par le domaine de la gestion hospitalière au sein d'un hôpital universitaire et souhaitez participer directement à l'amélioration continue de la prise en charge des patients et patientes et de la qualité des soins. \*\*Qualifications\*\* Vous avez une formation professionnelle et/ou académique supérieure, telle qu'un Master en Sciences économiques, un diplôme d'expertise comptable, ou diplôme reconnu équivalent. Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 5 ans minimum dans le domaine de l'audit des risques financiers ou dans une fonction d'analyse et de contrôle connexe (Ex. : achats, fournisseurs, révisions comptables, facturation, appels d'offre, logistique ou gestion immobilière) au cours de laquelle vous avez conduit en toute autonomie des missions d'audit. La certification CIA (Certified Internal Auditor) et/ou CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) sont pré\\-requises. Des compétences dans les domaines de cybersécurité, gouvernance des systèmes d'information et protection des données ainsi qu'une expérience des audits des projets informatiques, des transformations numériques et de continuité des systèmes critiques et résilience opérationnels sont des atouts. Vous démontrez une parfaite maîtrise de la comptabilité générale ; une expérience en comptabilité analytique constitue un atout. Être titulaire du certificat ECDL Advanced sur Word, Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, macros, calculs automatisés, plannings, graphiques, bases de données...) et Powerpoint est un atout. Vous possédez une grande capacité à gérer le stress et à respecter des délais serrés, tout en assurant des prestations de qualité. Votre excellente aptitude à travailler en équipe vous permet de collaborer étroitement avec les auditeurs et auditrices et les professionnels et professionnelles de santé. Personne dynamique et méthodique, vous faites preuve d'un esprit d'analyse et de synthèse pour faire face à des situations complexes et en constantes évolutions. Organisation, rigueur et sens du détail sont des compétences incontournables pour réussir les missions d'audit et autres activités qui vous sont confiées. Votre aisance relationnelle et votre force de persuasion facilitent les interactions que vous avez avec les différents services de l'institution. Vous êtes en mesure de gérer plusieurs tâches de manière simultanée (gestion des priorités, hiérarchisation des demandes, flexibilité). De très bonnes aptitudes en communication française, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit, vous sont demandées ainsi que des connaissances de l'allemand ou de l'anglais. Votre esprit d'équipe et votre facilité à intégrer un nouvel environnement sont essentiels pour rejoindre l'institution et l'équipe de la DAI. \*\*Informations supplémentaires\*\* \* Entrée en fonction : à définir \* Nombre de poste: 1 \* Taux d'activité : 100% \* Classe de fonction : 21 \* Contrat : CDI \* Délaide candidature : \* Demande de renseignements : M. J.\\-C. Esaki, Directeur de l'audit interne,\[Écrire un email\](\< \>) Votre dossier de candidature doit comporter une lettre démontrant votre motivation, votre curriculum vitae, les copies des diplômes et attestations requis pour le poste et les 2 derniers certificats de travail. Cette annonce s'adresse indistinctement aux femmes et aux hommes. Souhaitant s'engager dans la lutte contre le chômage, les HUG encouragent les candidatures qui proviennent de l'Office cantonal de l'emploi. Seules les candidatures soumises via la plateforme de recrutement sont prises en compte. Les candidatures papier et mail ne seront pas traitées. !\[\]( ) jpidf21dbeejm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

Embedded Software Engineer / Consumer Electronics \& Applied AI
===============================================================

### Embedded Software Engineer / Consumer Electronics \& Applied AI

Helbling Technik works as an engineering services partner: we develop products in\-house for our client's projects. Our multidisciplinary project teams bring together hardware, software, and mechanical engineers to deliver complete solutions. This role centers on two core focus areas: developing embedded software on System\-on\-Module (SoM) platforms from various providers, and applying AI on embedded devices. You will work on consumer electronics, smart home, and smart devices built for mass production, with or without connectivity.

### Tätigkeitsgebiet

You take embedded software from architecture to deployment, working closely with electronics and mechanical colleagues throughout. Concretely:

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable énergie du parc immobilier --- Responsable énergie du parc immobilier ======================================= Entité organisationnelle Division Bâtiments Logistique Fonction Ingénieur\\-e ets spécialiste Code fonction 104020 Classe maximum 17 Corps Personnel administratif et technique Taux d'activité 100% Délai d'inscription Référence 7133 Description du poste -------------------- L'Université de Genève exploite un parc immobilier de plus de 200'000 m², comprenant des bâtiments d'enseignement, de recherche avec des infrastructures techniques complexes en sciences et en médecine. Avec un budget énergétique d'environ 18 MCHF/an et un niveau de consommation parmi les plus élevés du canton, la maîtrise de l'énergie constitue un enjeu stratégique majeur. Dans un contexte de transition énergétique, de tension sur les coûts d'exploitation et de complexité croissante des installations, l'Université crée un poste de Responsable énergie afin de renforcer sa capacité interne à piloter la performance énergétique, maîtriser durablement ses coûts et conduire la transformation environnementale de son parc immobilier. Vous intervenez de manière transverse sur les bâtiments en propriété, en location ainsi que sur les bâtiments exploités par des tiers lorsque l'Université supporte les charges énergétiques. Votre rôle a une double finalité : maîtriser durablement les consommations et les coûts énergétiques et conduire la réduction de l'empreinte environnementale du parc dans une trajectoire de décarbonation. description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Ingénieur des ventes -- Machines industrielles (H/F) --- Ingénieur des ventes -- Machines industrielles (H/F) ====================================================== \*\*Merci de consulter cette annonce.\*\* Notre cabinet de recrutement \*\*FOKUS Talent\*\* est spécialisé dans les secteurs high\\-tech. Afin de poursuivre son développement sur plusieurs marchés stratégiques, elle recherche aujourd'hui un·e \*\*Ingénieur des ventes\*\* capable de prendre en charge le développement commercial d'une zone géographique et d'accompagner des clients industriels dans leurs projets d'investissement. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où la vente nécessite de comprendre les enjeux industriels du client, de construire une solution avec les équipes techniques et de piloter des cycles commerciaux pouvant impliquer plusieurs interlocuteurs et décideurs. \*\*Challenges\*\* Votre objectif sera de développer durablement votre territoire en combinant \*\*prospection, gestion de comptes existants et développement d'un réseau international de partenaires\*\*. Vous devrez identifier de nouveaux projets industriels, comprendre les besoins et contraintes des utilisateurs, puis coordonner les différentes expertises internes afin de construire une proposition technique et commerciale pertinente. Le challenge consiste également à transformer des cycles de vente complexes en projets rentables, tout en développant une relation de confiance à long terme avec les clients. \*\*Vos missions\*\* susceptibles d'investir dans les technologies proposées. \* Construire une démarche de prospection adaptée aux spécificités de chaque marché. \* Développer de nouvelles opportunités auprès de clients industriels et les accompagner jusqu'à la décision d'investissement. \* Négocier les conditions commerciales et conduire les discussions jusqu'à la conclusion des contrats. \*\*Gestion \\\& développement des comptes\*\* \* Entretenir une relation régulière avec les clients existants et identifier leurs futurs besoins. \* Développer le potentiel commercial des comptes déjà actifs. \* Comprendre les projets d'investissement, contraintes de production et objectifs industriels de vos interlocuteurs. \* Construire une relation commerciale durable avec les différents décideurs impliqués. \*\*Solutions technico\\-commerciales\*\* \* Analyser les besoins clients afin de proposer une configuration adaptée à leur environnement de production. \* Préparer et coordonner les propositions commerciales et techniques avec les spécialistes internes. \* Faire le lien entre le marché et les départements ingénierie, développement et service. \* Participer aux réflexions concernant l'évolution des solutions et transmettre de manière structurée les attentes observées sur le terrain. \*\*Réseau \\\& représentation internationale\*\* \* Développer et animer un réseau de partenaires commerciaux sur les marchés concernés. \* Identifier de nouvelles collaborations permettant d'accroître la présence de l'entreprise à l'international. \* Représenter la société auprès des clients, partenaires et acteurs de votre secteur. \* Participer à des salons professionnels et événements industriels internationaux. \* Effectuer régulièrement des déplacements afin de rencontrer les clients et développer les marchés directement sur le terrain. ### Requirements \*\*Profil recherché\*\* \* Formation technique supérieure dans les domaines de la \*\*mécanique, mécatronique, ingénierie industrielle\*\* ou parcours jugé équivalent. \* Expérience d'au moins \*\*5 ans dans la commercialisation de solutions ou équipements techniques B2B\*\*. \* Une expérience dans la vente de \*\*machines, lignes de production, équipements automatisés ou biens d'investissement industriels\*\* constitue un réel avantage. \* Capacité à comprendre un besoin industriel et à échanger avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme avec des décideurs commerciaux. \* Expérience des cycles de vente impliquant prospection, élaboration d'offres, négociation et conclusion de contrats. \* Très bonnes capacités relationnelles et aptitude à développer des partenariats sur le long terme. \* Autonomie, persévérance et capacité à organiser efficacement votre activité commerciale. \* \*\*Allemand langue maternelle\*\*, avec une bonne maîtrise du \*\*français et de l'anglais\*\*. Toute langue supplémentaire constitue un avantage. \* Aisance dans un contexte international et multiculturel. \* Disponibilité pour voyager régulièrement à l'étranger, représentant environ \*\*30 à 50 % du temps de travail\*\*. \*\*Ce que vous trouverez ici\*\* \* Une fonction commerciale internationale avec une réelle autonomie sur votre territoire. \* Des solutions industrielles à forte composante technique nécessitant une véritable approche de vente conseil. \* Des contacts directs avec des entreprises et décideurs industriels à travers différents marchés internationaux. \* Une collaboration quotidienne avec des équipes techniques, ingénierie, service et développement. \* La possibilité de suivre vos opportunités depuis l'identification du besoin jusqu'à la concrétisation du projet. \* Un rôle permettant d'avoir une influence directe sur le développement commercial et la présence internationale de l'entreprise. \*\*Processus de recrutement\*\* Veuillez noter que seuls les candidats titulaires d'un \*\*passeport suisse ou européen\*\* peuvent être pris en compte pour ce poste. B. Schulungen und Kampagnen zur Steigerung des Bewusstseins /Awareness der Mitarbeiterschaft bezüglich der Thematik der Informationssicherheit)* Unterstützung bei fachspezifischen Fragen aus Projekten oder dem Betrieb als Fachexperte (bspw. Prüfen von Dokumenten, Konzepten und Empfehlungen wie DSFA, etc.)* Überwachung der Einhaltung von Datenschutzvorschriften gemäss DSMS und Beratung verschiedene Bereiche der PDAG in Datenschutzfragen* Die Leistungserbringung erfolgt im Auftrag Leitung IDM der PDAG für mehrere Standorte sowie für die Psychiatrie Baselland**Benefits**Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel: Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Ebenfalls investieren wir viel in den Teamzusammenhalt und bieten allen unseren Teams den Zugang zur Software «Moodtalk» an, mit der die Teamkommunikation gestärkt wird. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko\-Bonus ausbezahlt. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Auch die Work\-Life\-Balance wird bei uns gefördert: Wir sind jederzeit offen für Teilzeitarbeit und offerieren die Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf.**Fragen zur Stelle?**Leiter Innovations\- und Digitalisierungsmanagement![Psychiatrische Dienste Aargau AG]()jid12a6686jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Embedded Software Engineer / Consumer Electronics \& Applied AI
===============================================================

### Embedded Software Engineer / Consumer Electronics \& Applied AI

Helbling Technik works as an engineering services partner: we develop products in\-house for our client's projects. Our multidisciplinary project teams bring together hardware, software, and mechanical engineers to deliver complete solutions. This role centers on two core focus areas: developing embedded software on System\-on\-Module (SoM) platforms from various providers, and applying AI on embedded devices. You will work on consumer electronics, smart home, and smart devices built for mass production, with or without connectivity.

### Tätigkeitsgebiet

You take embedded software from architecture to deployment, working closely with electronics and mechanical colleagues throughout. Concretely:

* Contribute to embedded software architecture and design within multidisciplinary project teams
* Implement firmware and software for microcontrollers and System\-on\-Modules (SoM) based consumer electronics products, across bare\-metal and RTOS environments
* Work with SoMs from various providers ( , Kontron, Toradex), including embedded Linux
* Integrate connectivity stacks (BLE, Wi\-Fi, Zigbee/Thread)
* Apply AI on embedded platforms: deploy pre\-trained models for on\-device inference (edge AI / Ti\-nyML), integrate vendor AI/NPU SDKs for features such as voice, gesture, or presence detection, and structure sensor data pipelines feeding AI or cloud systems
* Write and execute unit, integration, and system\-level tests
* Debug issues across the hardware/software boundary, perform root cause analysis
* Prepare technical documentation: requirements, design notes, test reports
* Collaborate directly with customer engineering teams as part of project delivery
* Work independently on assigned projects, with mentorship from senior engineers


### Anforderung

* BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* Minimum three years of professional experience in embedded software development
* Strong C/C\+\+ programming skills on embedded systems
* Python programming skills
* Practical experience with RTOS and/or bare\-metal environments
* Experience with embedded Linux ( , Yocto) on SoM platforms
* Experience integrating connectivity stacks ( , BLE, Wi\-Fi, Zigbee/Thread)
* Hands\-on experience applying AI on embedded platforms
* Nice to have
* electronics knowledge (analog/digital circuits, reading schematics)
* knowledge of product compliance/safety standards ( , IEC 60335 or equivalent)
* experience with specific edge AI frameworks ( , TensorFlow)
* experience using LLM\-assisted coding tools ( , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) in a development workflow
* knowledge in RUST programming language
* Work independently, open to mentorship from senior engineers
* Clear communicator across disciplines and with customers
* Curious, adapts quickly to new technologies
* Fluent in English is required, German is a plus


Helbling Benefits
-----------------

* Products that matter: you shape devices that reach real users in markets worldwide. The hardware decisions you make today end up in production runs tomorrow.
* Technical depth: every project brings new circuit challenges, new standards, and real constraints. No two are the same.
* Interdisciplinary teams: daily collaboration with experienced mechanical, firmware, and hardware specialists.
* Room to grow: structured support for technical and professional development, with access to the broader Helbling network across disciplines.
* Straightforward workplace: flat structures, short decision paths, and a working environment where clever ideas move forward quickly.
* Central Bern location: modern offices, easy to reach, with flexible working conditions and competitive, performance\-based compensation.


Are you interested?
-------------------

Send us your complete application, including cover letter, CV, and relevant references, exclusively via our applicant portal.

 

Please note that we only consider direct applications. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Quantitative LNG Analyst
description: The position is based on the Geneva trading floor, with regular contact with Houston, Singapore and Paris based teams.JOB DIMENSIONS The Modelling and Analysis for Trading Strategies team aims at providing a better understanding of the markets traded by TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP) in terms of prices and fundamentals, finding ways to model and forecast their dynamics and dealing with complex issues requiring a quantitative approach.  The Gas/LNG/Dry Modelling and Analysis team is formed of market fundamentals experts and quantitative researchers. In a context of great autonomy, the team contributes with interpretation of market, advisory and support to all TGP trading desks and to senior management - including COMEX members - and helps them define trading strategies and take investment decisions. The job holder influences the global TGP trading performance and works with trading desks and other stakeholders throughout the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging data in order to help traders take positions on the market and more broadly the Company to catch new business opportunities. This requires in-depth analysis of complex and unique problems as well as creative and strategic thinking.The holder of the position will work on the Global Gas balance, with particular focus and responsibility on maintaining existing analytical tools and create new ones. Excellent coding capabilities and quantitative mindset are required.  ACTIVITIESYou will be at the forefront of development of scalable, reusable, and intelligent frameworks that contribute to long-term P&L growth, ensuring they are built as maintainable, long-living, production-grade solutions. You will build extensible frameworks that evolve with business needs and are used across Gas&LNG trading desks. You will iteratively enhance these frameworks to support rapid feature delivery while minimizing technical debt and ensuring long-term maintainability. You will provide support to users (data scientists from MATS teams and traders) by leveraging your solid understanding of the tools developed in the team. You will facilitate their work by clearly presenting the features and guiding them to fully utilize the capabilities of the frameworks, ensuring they can maximize their potential. You will collaborate with key partner teams (e.g. Algo Strategies, Modelling & Analysis) to co-develop specialized tools, ensuring flexibility for researchers while maintaining core architectural standards. You will work on a variety of different problems related to energy and commodity markets and acquire business knowledge.  CONTEXT AND ENVIRONMENTTotalEnergies Gas and Power is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low carbon energies (mainly gas, LNG and power). As such it operates in fast-evolving market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation and evolution. Uncertainties specific to the trading environment (volatility of prices, supply & demand mismatches) are coupled with those coming from the broader energy sector (climate change policies, changes in the energy mix, developments of new energy sources, etc). In such context Trading helps to ensure growth and profitability to a key segment of the business in order to reach the objective of Carbon Neutrality by 2050.ACCOUNTABILITIESTest and integrate advanced techniques and quantitative algorithms, with a focus on continuous improvement.  Participate in the definition of the forward view of the iGas desksHelp build and communicate a global view of energy markets, enhance the Company’s understanding of energy markets interactionsContribute to the management of the relationship with the related Total entities and clients of the Research team.QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE REQUIREDStrong technical or engineering background with a MSc in Comp. Science, Mathematics, Physics or EngineeringAt least 2 years experience on similar roles covering LNG and/or Natural Gas in a trading environment.A curious individual with a strong team spirit, always seeking to improve and innovate beyond the status quo. Strong ability to adapt to continuously changing environment.Programming skills (Python,SQL,), as well as familiarity with Optimization frameworks and statistical methods;Fluent in English (oral and written) – knowledge of French and/or other languages is an advantage;The position requires autonomy, objectivity, innovation, to be resourceful and well organisedThe ideal candidate should be able to explain complex issues and present them in a clear and concise manner. He/she should demonstrate openness when their ideas are challenged, and bring a proactive approach.
